UnitStatement: A document whose version equals the supported version is classified "current" with persistence_state "stored_document_current" and no migration applied.

UnitStatement: A document newer than the supported version is classified "newer_than_supported" and refused for editing with no down-migration.

UnitStatement: For documents older than supported, the evaluator walks the ordered transform chain step by step until reaching the supported version.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: When the walk reaches the supported version, status is "migrated" with persistence_state "in_memory_only_not_yet_saved"; stored bytes are unchanged until save.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: If no chain step matches the current version, status is "unsupported_schema" with detail "No migration path exists ...", refusing to open without coercion.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: On a successful step apply, the walker stamps the next document's schema_version to the step target_version (inserting the key if absent) and records the migration id.

UnitStatement: If a transform step returns Err, status is "failed" with no migrated document and detail naming the failing migration id.

UnitStatement: changeInputSourceKind: switching to private_library_value seeds a placeholder library_value_ref when none exists, and switching to solver_result seeds a placeholder solver_result_ref, so the sub-form opens with a complete schema-valid (unresolved, blocking) reference.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Switching a required input's source_kind away from a reference kind leaves any existing reference in place (lossless); its sub-form stays visible so a now-meaningless reference is never silently hidden, and an explicit Remove control lets the user drop it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: updateInputLibraryRef merges a patch into the existing library_value_ref (or a fresh default when none exists) so the first field edit always produces a complete four-member reference, never a schema-invalid partial.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: removeInputLibraryRef drops the library_value_ref member entirely — the only member-removing edit the editor exposes — while every other member of the input round-trips verbatim.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: removeInputSolverRef drops the solver_result_ref member entirely, returning the input to the run-panel caller-supplied binding path, with every other member round-tripping verbatim.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Removing a required input is blocked when only one remains, with the stated reason "A rule pack needs at least one required input."
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Removing a value slot is blocked when only one remains, with the stated reason "A rule pack needs at least one value slot."
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The private-library reference sub-form is shown whenever the input draws from a private library OR whenever a reference is already present, so a reference left over from a since-changed source_kind stays visible and removable rather than silently hidden.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The referenced private-library value is resolved at check-run time from the local private library store; it stays in the library and is never embedded in the rule pack.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: A solver-result reference binds the input to a specific row of the solved result envelope by result id, resolved at check-run time; an authored reference is the canonical binding that supersedes the run panel's per-input result selector.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ExpressionComposer.test.tsx (TP-C2-COMPOSER-001) tests the structured AST expression composer; pure-helper tests pin grammar v1.0.0 node encoding and the lossless document rewrite, component tests drive visible controls.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: collectRulePackVariables collects declared required-input and value-slot variables, yielding ids user_required_input_1 (required_input) and user_limit_slot_1 (value_slot) for the draft document.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The schema's ExpressionQuantity is additionalProperties:false and allows only value/dimension/unit_ref; the unit_required/dimension_check_required relaxation flags are not authorable in pack documents (absent means true).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The unknown-dimension placeholder is the uppercase "TBD" token the codec (decode_quantity) and schema DimensionId accept — never lowercase "tbd".
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: defaultExpressionNode("literal") equals {node:literal, quantity:{value:0, dimension:TBD, unit_ref:TBD}}.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: A default table node carries two strictly-increasing rows so interpolate is immediately well-formed, with TBD placeholders; a lookup node additionally carries an exact mode.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The dimension vocabulary offers only the codec/schema tokens with the uppercase TBD placeholder; a lowercase "tbd" default (the slice-2 regression) produced documents that fail backend decode and DimensionId schema validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Table nodes (interpolate, lookup) are editable as of slice 3; refusal markers and unknown tags remain non-editable and are preserved read-only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: setFormulaExpression rewrites one formula's expression AST while preserving the untouched sibling formula and the payload's other members (e.g. payload_kind).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: parseRulePackDocument reports failure honestly: null text yields no-draft, invalid JSON and a top-level array are rejected, and a valid object yields {ok:true, document}.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: renderExpressionText renders a read-only AST text preview without changing canonical AST shape, e.g. a compare/divide tree renders as "((stress_actual / 2 1 [dimensionless]) <= stress_limit)".
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: renderExpressionText renders unsafe_host_access as "[refusal:unsafe_host_access]" and an unrecognized node as "[unrecognized:future_feature]".
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Adding a table row appends with strict monotonicity (last argument + 1); the last row cannot be removed because the schema requires at least one row.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Editing a table node's argument expression preserves the table metadata and rows verbatim — only the argument subtree changes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: An unrecognized node renders read-only with an honest explanation and survives intact when an editable sibling is edited (not dropped or rewritten).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Refusal-marker nodes (unsupported_form / unsafe_host_access) are always read-only, expose no node-type selector so they cannot be silently switched, and round-trip byte-for-byte.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ExpressionComposer is the structured AST expression composer (Phase C2 slice 2, TP-C2-COMPOSER-001), a recursive form/tree composer that builds the frozen grammar v1.0.0 typed AST (DEC-022) so a user never writes node-tagged JSON by hand.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: PRD §14.5 requires the rule-pack editor to provide an Expression editor.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The composer boundary (D-02b RULED, DEC-037) is purely structured: it may show a labeled read-only one-way AST-to-text preview but provides no writable expression text input and no parser; the typed AST remains the sole canonical checksum-bound form (DEC-022).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Table-backed nodes (interpolate / lookup) are authored through a structured table sub-editor (TP-C2-TABLENODE-001): table id, argument/result dimension and unit refs, the {argument, result} rows, plus the recursive argument expression.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Monotonicity and out-of-range remain evaluator-enforced diagnostics surfaced as authoring guidance, never silently clamped in the composer.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Expression literal/table unit refs use the reviewed DEC-018 catalog when the desktop backend exposes it; browser preview keeps manual unit text and stored out-of-catalog units remain visible and selectable (TP-UNITS-B2-RULEEXPRUNITS-001).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Any unrecognized node tag and the refusal markers (unsupported_form / unsafe_host_access) are rendered read-only and preserved verbatim; the composer never silently drops or rewrites a subtree it does not edit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: EDITABLE_NODE_TYPES is the full frozen grammar v1.0.0 set: literal, variable_ref, unary, binary, compare, logical, select, aggregate, interpolate, lookup; refusal markers and unrecognized tags are excluded.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: UNARY_OPERATORS are negate, abs, not.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: BINARY_OPERATORS are add, subtract, multiply, divide.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: COMPARE_OPERATORS are less_than, less_than_or_equal, greater_than, greater_than_or_equal, equal, not_equal.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: LOGICAL_OPERATORS are and, or.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: AGGREGATE_FUNCTIONS are min, max.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: LOOKUP_MODES are exact, step.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The DIMENSIONS vocabulary matches the document codec and schema (core/rules/rule_pack_document DIMENSION_TOKENS == schema DimensionId == evaluator Dimension enum), with uppercase TBD as the honest unknown-dimension authoring default.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: DIMENSIONS enumerates dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, temperature_interval, angle, rotation, force, moment, pressure, stress, area, volume, density, linear_stiffness, rotational_stiffness, displacement, velocity, acceleration, thermal_conductivity, specific_heat, thermal_expansion_coefficient, second_moment_area, section_modulus, mass_per_length, volume_per_length, slope, TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: FormulaDeclaration carries index, id, kind, and the expression AST node.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: parseRulePackDocument parses draft document text into an object, honestly reporting failure as no-draft, invalid-json, or not-an-object.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: collectRulePackVariables collects the variable identifiers a variable_ref may bind — declared required inputs and value slots; solver-result fields are bound at evaluation time, not invented into the picker.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: readFormulaDeclarations reads the formula declarations and their expression ASTs, defaulting a missing expression to {node:unrecognized} and formula_kind to derived_quantity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: setFormulaExpression returns a new document with formulaId's expression AST replaced, preserving every other member and every other formula by structural copy.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: nodeKind returns the declared node tag of an AST node, or "unrecognized" when absent.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: isEditableNode returns whether a node's kind is in EDITABLE_NODE_TYPES.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: isTableNode returns whether a node is an interpolate or lookup node.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: defaultLiteral returns {node:literal, quantity:{value:0, dimension:TBD, unit_ref:TBD}}; the relaxation flags are omitted because the codec/evaluator treat absent flags as true (strict).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: defaultUserTable returns a schema-valid table with two strictly-increasing rows so an interpolate node is immediately well-formed (evaluator requires at least two rows and strict monotonicity), with TBD dimension/unit placeholders.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: defaultExpressionNode(type, variables) returns a sensible default node of the given editable type used when creating or switching nodes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: renderExpressionText provides deterministic read-only rendering for DEC-037's permitted one-way AST text preview; it is display-only, no parser consumes the string, and the AST remains the canonical checksummed member.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: DimensionSelect is a shared dimension picker over the codec/schema vocabulary, reused by the literal editor and both table dimension fields, and exported so the declarations editor draws from the same single vocabulary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: DimensionSelect performs no silent display-snap: a stored token outside the current vocabulary surfaces as a "(current)" option rather than being shown as TBD while the document still holds the real token (CONTRACT no-silent-defaults).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ExpressionNodeEditor renders refusal markers and unrecognized node tags read-only with the subtree round-tripping unchanged; table-backed nodes are editable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The table sub-editor patches only the touched row while every other row object round-trips verbatim (updateRow).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: addRow appends a new row with argument equal to the last argument + 1 (or 0 when empty) to preserve strict monotonicity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Table guidance states row arguments must be strictly increasing, interpolate needs at least two rows, and the evaluator blocks out-of-range arguments — it never extrapolates or clamps.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: An aggregate node defaults its function to min and blocks removing its last operand with the reason "An aggregate needs at least one operand."
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ExpressionComposer renders the full composer surface: a variable browser, a formula selector, and the recursive node editor for the selected formula's expression AST; the parent owns serialization and persistence.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: RulePackManagerPanel.test.tsx (Phase C2 slice 1, TP-C2-EDITOR-001) pins the honest browser-preview seam: jsdom has no Tauri runtime, so drafts stay in memory and every backend action reports the explicit desktop-only diagnostic instead of a synthesized fallback.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: RulePackManagerPanel scopes the manager to the loaded project, showing "create or open a local project first" without one and the project id plus "local SQLite only" with one.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: A new draft is private-by-default: rule_pack_kind open_pipe_stress_rule_pack, grammar_version 1.0.0, classification privacy_class private_user_data and redistribution_status private_only; discard clears the draft.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: In browser preview, validate and refresh-list backend actions report the explicit RULE-PACK-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Compute-checksum and save route to the desktop-only seam (RULE-PACK-BACKEND-DESKTOP-ONLY) from a clean draft state in browser preview.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Save is blocked with the honest reason "create or open a local project first" when no project is loaded.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Invalid draft JSON is reported honestly as RULE-PACK-DRAFT-JSON-INVALID instead of being acted upon.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The boundary note keeps the DEC-037 and professional boundaries visible: read-only, no expression text parser, never committed to the repository, never a code-compliance claim.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The structured composer is revealed only with a draft, and a structured edit (switching the formula's root node to compare) rewrites the canonical document JSON the validate/save flow reads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The declarations editor and expression composer read the same draft document (slice 4, TP-C2-DECLEDITOR-001), so a required input added through the editor is immediately bindable in the composer's variable picker — no raw JSON.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The check-definitions editor (slice 5, TP-C2-CHECKDEF-001) reads the same draft document; adding a check grows the canonical document JSON.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: A freshly declared required input is immediately bindable in a check's reference picker, since the declarations editor and check editor read the same draft.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: buildDraftRulePackDocument builds a schema-shaped private draft with schema_version 0.4.0, grammar_version 1.0.0, payload grammar_status frozen_open_pipe_stress_declared_expression, and a variable_ref root expression.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The draft professional_boundary sets software_makes_compliance_claim false and human_review_required true.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: stampChecksumIntoDocument stamps a computed checksum (sha256, JCS canonicalization, payload_scope rule_pack_payload, basis rfc8785_jcs_sha256_excluding_checksums) into checksums.rule_pack_checksum with verification_status verified, without touching other members.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: RulePackManagerPanel.tsx is the desktop Rule-Pack Manager (PRD §14.5 / §14.1): list/create/open/save/delete packs against the local-only store, with validation findings and checksum generation/stamping.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The rule-pack manager operates against a local-only store; packs are project-scoped and nothing is stored until the user saves.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Rule-pack authoring was built in slices: slice 1 raw canonical JSON; slice 2 structured AST expression composer; slice 3 table-backed nodes; slice 4 variable-declarations editor; slice 5 check-definitions editor.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The full grammar v1.0.0 node set (DEC-022) is built through form/tree controls rather than hand-written JSON.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The raw document JSON remains the canonical/fallback surface for remaining metadata members: diagnostics, classification, checksums, provenance, professional_boundary, open_decisions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: DEC-037 permits a labeled read-only one-way AST-to-text preview, but provides no writable expression text syntax or parser.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: NO_DRAFT_REASON: no draft rule-pack document exists; create a new draft or open a stored pack first.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: NO_PROJECT_REASON: local rule packs are project-scoped; create or open a local project first.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: BUSY_REASON: a rule-pack backend request is in progress; wait for it to finish before editing or running another action.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: RulePackR3JourneyEvent enumerates rule-pack journey events: rule_pack_draft_created, rule_pack_validate_requested, rule_pack_checksum_requested, rule_pack_save_requested.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: An in-request busy guard (inFlight) disables the draft editors and all actions while a backend command is awaiting, so an async response cannot clobber a mid-request edit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: When the active project changes, the previously-listed packs are cleared (they belong to the old project), but the session draft is intentionally preserved until saved.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Backend (Tauri) commands can reject in desktop mode; browser preview short-circuits to an explicit unavailable route, while a desktop backend error is surfaced honestly rather than as a silent unhandled rejection.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: parseDraft validates that the draft text is a JSON object (not array/null/primitive), reporting RULE-PACK-DRAFT-JSON-INVALID on failure.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: handleNewDraft creates a new private draft in memory with privacy_class=private_user_data and redistribution_status=private_only; nothing is stored until saved.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: handleRefreshList lists local rule packs for the project; browser preview returns route unavailable_browser_preview.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: handleValidate validates the draft document and reports blocking_findings, checksum match_status, and grammar_supported.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: handleComputeChecksum computes the rule-pack checksum, stamps it into the draft document, and reports the basis and payload_excludes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: handleSave requires a project; it saves the draft to the local store, reporting rule_pack_id and storage_mode, then refreshes the list.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: handleOpen loads a stored rule pack from the local store into the draft and shows its validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: handleDelete deletes a stored rule pack from the local store and refreshes the list.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Structured editors (composer, declarations, check-definitions) re-serialize the edited document back into the canonical draft text, the single source of truth the validate/checksum/save flow reads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The rule-pack document JSON is the native canonical form; the editors author required-input/value-slot declarations, the formula expression AST (declarative-AST per DEC-022 including table-backed nodes), and acceptability check definitions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Boundary note: private rule packs stay in local project storage only and are never committed, transmitted, or bundled into public artifacts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Boundary note: rule-check output is a software computation over user-supplied data, never a code-compliance, certification, sealing, approval, or professional acceptance claim.

UnitStatement: Private rule packs persist in the local SQLite store only and are never transmitted or committed (OPS-K-PRIV-1, PRD §17.3).

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: LocalStorageCapability describes the local store: engine (e.g. SQLite), bundled, fts5_available, network_required, daemon_required, telemetry_enabled, path/large_file policies, database_path, compile_options, migration_framework/status, schema versions, and migrations_applied_on_open.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: LocalProjectSummary summarizes a local project's id/name, database_path, storage_mode, migration status/framework, schema versions, fts_indexed, copied_external_files, and counts/refs for editor intents, proposals, review targets, mechanics results, analysis runs, and model/envelope hashes, plus unit_round_trip status/signature.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: LocalProjectIndexEntry carries project_id, project_name, storage_mode (local_sqlite|browser_memory_preview|string), created_at_unix, and updated_at_unix.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ModelHashEvidence records a model hash using algorithm sha256, canonicalization rfc8785_jcs, payload_scope model_payload, payload_ref, value, and hash_status computed_local_preview.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ModelHashIntegrityEvidence reports integrity_status (verified_match|mismatch_review_required|not_persisted|hash_recompute_unavailable), persisted and recomputed values, payload_ref, and verification_basis recomputed_on_open_from_restored_model.

UnitStatement: ProjectEnvelopeHashEvidence records the project envelope hash (sha256, rfc8785_jcs) over payload_scope project_envelope_payload excluding storage_summary_and_envelope_hash_carrier_fields.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ProjectEnvelopeHashIntegrityEvidence reports envelope hash integrity_status, persisted/recomputed values, payload_ref, and verification_basis recomputed_on_open_from_restored_envelope_payload.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: PackageHashEvidence records a package_review_payload hash (sha256, rfc8785_jcs) excluding validation-report/manifest package-hash carrier fields.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ModelDocumentMigrationStatus reports status (current|migrated|newer_than_supported|unsupported_schema|failed), source/target schema versions, migration_framework, db and product schema migration statuses, applied_migration_ids, persistence_state, and detail.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: ModelMigrationLedgerRecord records a migration event with record_kind, recorded_at_unix, source/target schema versions, applied_migration_ids, migration_framework, pre/post migration model hashes, trigger, destructive_rewrite flag, and professional_boundary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: LocalProjectEnvelope aggregates summary, model, editor_intents, proposal, selected_review_target, mechanics_result, analysis_run, model_hash, project_envelope_hash, model_document_migration, and model_migration_ledger.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Build-time guard TP-APP-R2-WASMPKG-001: the wasm operation engine is the sole browser-mode engine (DEC-020 / ADR-0001), so a production bundle missing public/wasm-engine/ assets is broken by construction and must fail the build loudly.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The required wasm engine asset filenames are open_pipe_stress_operation_applier.js and open_pipe_stress_operation_applier_bg.wasm.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: missingWasmEngineAssets(dir) returns the wasm engine asset filenames absent from dir/wasm-engine/.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: wasmEngineGuardError raises a WASM-ENGINE-ASSET-ABSENT error naming the missing assets and instructing to build with `npm run build:wasm --workspace apps/desktop` and rebuild, since no fallback engine exists.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: wasmEngineDistGuard is a build-only Vite plugin that checks public/wasm-engine/ at buildStart and dist/wasm-engine/ at closeBundle, throwing if assets are missing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The Vite config registers the react() plugin and wasmEngineDistGuard plugin and sets clearScreen false.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The dev server runs on port 5173 with strictPort false.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: manualChunks splits node_modules into vendor chunks: vendor-three (three), vendor-react (react/react-dom), vendor-icons (lucide-react), vendor-tauri (@tauri-apps), and a default vendor chunk.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The Vitest config uses the jsdom environment, globals, includes src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}, and the ./src/test/setup.ts setup file.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: Vitest test and hook timeouts are raised to 30000ms because the full <App /> renders flake at the default 5s timeout under load; a genuine 30s+ render indicates a real defect.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_APPS -> CAT-027.

UnitStatement: The adapters/framework package provides format-neutral adapter framework checks for OpenPipeStress.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The adapter framework module validates already-declared adapter metadata and invented fixture payloads; it does not parse external file formats, access files or network resources, choose transport/runtime behavior, or make legal/professional determinations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The package re-exports AdapterFinding, AdapterValidationResult, build_result, and validate_adapter_declaration from adapter_framework as its public API.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The DEL-10-02 adapter framework performs bounded in-memory validation and is deliberately format-neutral.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The framework checks adapter declarations and invented fixtures for no-bypass controls, provenance, unit metadata, privacy/export posture, and professional-boundary controls without parsing real external files or selecting a concrete import/export format.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: REQUIRED_TBD_DECISIONS lists adapter/framework decisions that must remain TBD in DEL-10-02: external_format_list, public_transport_protocol, endpoint_syntax, adapter_execution_model, plugin_runtime, permission_grant_persistence, package_scripts, ci_provider, release_matrix, physical_project_container, local_fea_package_format, redaction_workflow.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: REQUIRED_PROVENANCE_FIELDS requires source_name, source_location, source_license, contributor, contributor_certification, redistribution_status, and review_status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: REQUIRED_NO_BYPASS_TRUE defines mandatory no-bypass controls (e.g. must_use_public_api_boundary, must_preserve_provenance, must_not_access_network, must_not_claim_code_compliance) that adapters cannot disable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: REQUIRED_VALIDATION_PLAN requires schema_validation, unit_validation, dimension_validation, provenance_validation, redistribution_review, privacy_classification, and protected_content_screening.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: FORBIDDEN_STATUS_TERMS bans authority terms CODE_COMPLIANT, CERTIFIED, SEALED, APPROVED_FOR_PROFESSIONAL_RELIANCE, SECURITY_CERTIFIED, and COMPLIANCE_ATTESTED from adapter payloads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: FORBIDDEN_PERSISTENCE_PATTERNS are regex patterns blocking direct persistence access such as raw SQLite handles, database connections, SQL strings, table names, and direct project-store mutation hooks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The accepted privacy classification constant is public_permissive_reviewed (PUBLIC_REVIEWED).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: AdapterFinding is a frozen dataclass with fields code, severity, path, message, and remediation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: AdapterValidationResult is a frozen dataclass with outcome and findings; accepted is True only when outcome equals ACCEPTED_FORMAT_NEUTRAL_DECLARATION.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: validate_adapter_declaration validates a format-neutral adapter declaration payload by aggregating identity, framework-status, TBD-decision, adapter, validation-plan, operation-result, forbidden-term, and forbidden-persistence findings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: build_result builds a deterministic operation result envelope with parse_status not_parsed_by_framework, diagnostics, privacy posture, provenance, and professional_boundary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The adapter operation result sets parse_status to not_parsed_by_framework, signaling the framework does not parse real external files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The result privacy block sets local_first true, telemetry_allowed false, export_review_required true, and private_payload_redacted true.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: invented_provenance returns a fixed provenance dict marking the fixture as project-invented test data with review_status accepted.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: professional_boundary returns flags requiring human review, distinct mechanics-solve and user-rule-check, and all software compliance/certification/sealing/approval/security claims set false.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _validate_identity requires deliverable_id DEL-10-02, package_id PKG-10, scope_item SOW-030, and objective OBJ-009, emitting ADAPTER_TRACEABILITY_INVALID otherwise.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _validate_framework_status requires each TBD decision (except package_scripts) to equal TBD, emitting ADAPTER_RUNTIME_DECISION_NOT_TBD when a concrete runtime/transport/format choice is made.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Framework interface_kind must equal schema_first_format_neutral_adapter_framework, else ADAPTER_INTERFACE_KIND_INVALID.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _validate_tbd_decisions emits ADAPTER_TBD_DECISIONS_INCOMPLETE for missing keys and ADAPTER_DECISION_PREMATURE when a decision was resolved without a separate human ruling.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An adapter declaration whose format_status is not TBD triggers ADAPTER_FORMAT_SELECTED because concrete external formats must remain TBD in DEL-10-02.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Missing adapter capabilities trigger ADAPTER_CAPABILITIES_MISSING; adapters must declare bounded format-neutral capabilities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Each validation-plan hook must equal 'required', else ADAPTER_VALIDATION_HOOK_MISSING; adapters cannot bypass validation, provenance, privacy, or protected-content hooks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The validation plan must set human_review_required true, else ADAPTER_HUMAN_REVIEW_BOUNDARY_MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _validate_provenance emits ADAPTER_PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE for missing fields and ADAPTER_PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED (quarantine) when redistribution_status is protected_suspected.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _validate_privacy requires local_first true (ADAPTER_LOCAL_FIRST_REQUIRED) and telemetry_allowed false (ADAPTER_TELEMETRY_MUST_BE_DISABLED).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _validate_no_bypass emits ADAPTER_NO_BYPASS_CONTROL_DISABLED for any required control that is not True.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _validate_professional_boundary requires each professional_boundary flag to match expected values, else ADAPTER_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY_VIOLATED; adapter outputs must remain decision-support artifacts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _scan_forbidden_terms emits ADAPTER_FORBIDDEN_STATUS_TERM when any banned authority term appears in the payload.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _scan_forbidden_persistence_access emits ADAPTER_FORBIDDEN_PERSISTENCE_ACCESS when the payload exposes direct persistence access outside application-service commands/queries/jobs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _determine_outcome returns QUARANTINE if any quarantine severity is present, REJECTED if any blocking severity is present, otherwise ACCEPTED_FORMAT_NEUTRAL_DECLARATION.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _diagnostic_class maps finding codes to PROVENANCE_WARNING, PRIVACY_WARNING, IP_BOUNDARY_WARNING, or ADAPTER_BLOCKING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The analysis_runs package provides analysis-run record support for OpenPipeStress.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The package re-exports build_preview_analysis_run_envelope, canonical_json, and validate_analysis_run_envelope as its public API.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The records module builds immutable schema-shaped analysis-run records for DEL-14-02 from already-computed preview mechanics results.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The analysis-run record builder records provenance, diagnostics, result hashes, and professional-boundary flags; it does not run solvers, persist project files, evaluate code criteria, or make engineering acceptance claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Analysis-run records use SCHEMA_VERSION 0.1.0, DELIVERABLE_ID DEL-14-02, PACKAGE_ID PKG-14, SCOPE_ITEM SOW-072, and objective OBJ-016.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: IMMUTABILITY_POLICY marks the run record read-only: changes create a new analysis run, a new run is required for any change, and the hash invalidates external acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PHYSICAL_PROJECT_CONTAINER profile is sqlite_local_project_store (decision SCA-003) acting as a local store index projection over the canonical JCS JSON payload, with no public SQL contract, no direct SQL access, no hosted DB, and no network required.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RUN_CONTRACT_STATUS binds analysis-run records to schemas/model_state.schema.json and schemas/results.schema.yaml, with external_validation_boundary reference_only_not_determined_by_software.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: build_preview_analysis_run_envelope builds a deterministic DEL-14-02 wrapper around a preview mechanics result, taking refs for model state, settings, unit system, load basis, environment, solver, and build.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The analysis_run record captures run_id, run_kind mechanics_solve, solver_version with provenance, settings/unit/load refs, diagnostics, result_refs, hashes, analysis_status, reproducibility, immutability_policy, and professional_boundary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Reproducibility records unresolved_tbd items including physical project container and release-grade solver build provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: validate_analysis_run_envelope returns blocking diagnostics for core DEL-14-02 invariant violations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An analysis run must carry run_id, model_state_ref, solver_version, settings_ref, unit_system_ref, load_basis_refs, result_refs, hashes, analysis_status, immutability_policy, and professional_boundary, else ANALYSIS_RUN_FIELD_MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: analysis_status must include HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, else ANALYSIS_RUN_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED_MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A professional_boundary mismatch emits ANALYSIS_RUN_PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION; an immutability_policy mismatch emits ANALYSIS_RUN_IMMUTABILITY_POLICY_VIOLATION.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Each result_ref must carry hash_refs, else ANALYSIS_RUN_RESULT_HASH_MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: canonical_json serializes values with sorted keys and compact separators (JCS-style) for stable hashing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _result_ref builds a result reference with result_family, sha256 hash_refs over the result value, privacy_classification invented_public_example, and engine provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _diagnostic_class classifies diagnostics by code into RULE_CHECK_BLOCKING/ASSUMPTION_WARNING, UNIT_WARNING, PROVENANCE_WARNING, SOLVE_BLOCKING, or RUN_REPRODUCIBILITY_WARNING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _analysis_status always includes HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED plus any supplied mechanics and rule_check statuses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _result_family classifies a result into displacement, reaction, force, moment, stress, ratio, or TBD based on its id or kind.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _checksum produces a sha256 JCS checksum record with algorithm, canonicalization, payload_ref, payload_scope, and value.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The analysis-run comparison engine compares already-available analysis-run and result-envelope records for diagnostic OpenPipeStress reviews.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The comparison engine does not ingest external solver files, define numerical acceptance defaults, or make professional/code-compliance determinations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: COMPARABLE_MAPPING_STATUSES are automatic_match and manual_match.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: SUPPORTED_RESULT_FAMILIES are displacement, rotation, force, moment, reaction, stress, and ratio.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ComparisonDiagnostic is a frozen dataclass with code, severity, diagnostic_class, affected_refs, message, and remediation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ResultDelta is a frozen dataclass capturing mapping/result ids, family, dimension, normalized unit, magnitudes, raw and normalized deltas, tolerance refs, and classification with basis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: SettingsDelta is a frozen dataclass with setting_key, left_value, right_value, and delta_kind.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: AnalysisRunComparison aggregates comparison_id, run_context, result_deltas, settings_deltas, diagnostics, and professional_boundary, exposing has_blocking_findings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: compare_analysis_runs compares two analysis runs using explicit mappings and unit metadata, requiring caller-supplied mappings and conversions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Analysis-run comparison output always sets human_review_required true and all software compliance/certification/sealing/approval/authentication claims false.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _compare_mapping computes a ResultDelta for one mapping or returns None with a diagnostic when the comparison cannot proceed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A mapping whose status is not automatic_match or manual_match emits ARC-MAPPING-NOT-COMPARABLE and yields no delta.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A missing mapped result reference emits the blocking diagnostic ARC-RESULT-DATA-MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Unsupported or mismatched result families emit ARC-RESULT-FAMILY-UNSUPPORTED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Incompatible or missing dimensions emit the blocking diagnostic ARC-DIMENSION-INCOMPATIBLE.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Missing unit metadata emits the blocking diagnostic ARC-UNIT-MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Non-finite or missing magnitudes emit the blocking diagnostic ARC-MAGNITUDE-MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Absence of an explicit conversion path emits the blocking diagnostic ARC-UNIT-CONVERSION-UNSUPPORTED; the engine never invents conversions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A normalized delta is computed as right_normalized minus left_normalized after applying caller-supplied conversion factors.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classify_delta returns not_classified unless a tolerance profile and matching numeric rule (with a normalized unit) are supplied; within or exceeds tolerance is decided against caller-supplied tolerance values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _settings_deltas reports added, removed, or changed settings keys between left and right.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _numeric coerces a value to a finite float, returning None for bool, non-numeric, or non-finite values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The model-state comparison engine performs deterministic model-state comparison for DEL-14-03.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The model-state comparison engine is provider-neutral: callers supply immutable model state records or references plus explicit entity payloads; analysis-run result deltas are out of scope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: METADATA_FIELDS enumerates the model-state metadata carried into comparison output (state ids, refs, tags, assumptions, warnings, status, hashes, immutability_policy, professional_boundary, provenance).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Model-state PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY notes that comparison output is deterministic decision-support output requiring external human review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ModelStateComparisonError is raised when comparison input cannot be interpreted deterministically.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: compare_model_states compares two model states and returns a deterministic diff envelope, accepting optional explicit mappings and settings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Each entity must expose a stable identifier via stable_id, entity_id, id, ref, or reference.ref.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Entities sharing a stable_id on both sides are compared directly; explicit mappings then match remaining entities; leftover left/right entities are reported as removed/added.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A mapping overlapping an already-matched stable identifier emits DUPLICATE_MAPPING_BASIS and is skipped.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Comparison output reports comparison_kind model_state_to_model_state, engine DEL-14-03_model_state_comparison_v1, state refs, summary, entity rows, metadata, diagnostics, professional_boundary, and provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _state_view accepts either a raw model_state object or a wrapper with model_state plus an entities list, raising ModelStateComparisonError on malformed input.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _entity_index raises if an entity is not an object, lacks a stable identifier, or has a duplicated stable identifier within one side.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _mapping_pairs supports only entity mapping records, emitting UNSUPPORTED_MAPPING_CATEGORY for other kinds.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A mapping that is unresolved or omits a counterpart emits MAPPING_UNRESOLVED; a mapping referencing an absent entity emits MAPPING_TARGET_MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A mapping status that is not manual_match or automatic_match emits UNSUPPORTED_MAPPING_STATUS.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _changes reports field-level differences between two entities, ignoring identifier keys, using canonical JSON for equality.
