CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An operation is accepted only when it is an explicit accept candidate and no record diagnostic has blocking severity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _record_diagnostics emits a blocking AUDIT-EXPLICIT-USER-ACCEPTANCE-REQUIRED when neither accepted nor rejected, and adds acceptance-gate diagnostics for accept candidates.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _acceptance_gate_diagnostics requires passed schema/constraint/unit validation, generated diff preview, and not_applied application status before an accepted record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Accepted operation records require a hash-bound diff-preview reference (AUDIT-DIFF-PREVIEW-HASH-MISSING blocking otherwise).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Accepted operation records require a current accepted model-state hash (AUDIT-MODEL-STATE-HASH-MISSING blocking otherwise).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Accepted records require an operation precondition model_state_record current hash that matches the accepted model-state hash, else AUDIT-OPERATION-CURRENT-HASH-MISSING/MISMATCH blocking.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _explicit_user_acceptance is true only when the signal has accepted=true, decision 'accept', and actor_type 'user'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _decision_counts tallies records into accepted, rejected, and held_for_user_acceptance counts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: audit_record_id is 'audit:' + a 24-char truncated sha256 over the operation, validation outcome, diff-preview ref, acceptance signal, timestamp, rationale, and audit metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _state_hash resolves a model-state hash from state_hash, model_state_hash, or hash on the model-state or nested model_state mapping.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Crate open_pipe_stress_operation_applier (v0.1.0) provides structured editor-operation validation, diff preview, and an apply seam for OpenPipeStress model documents; publish=false.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: operation_applier builds as crate-type cdylib+rlib; cdylib supports a feature-gated wasm32 browser-engine build while rlib keeps the native library/test path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: operation_applier 'wasm' feature (DEC-020 / ADR-0001) enables wasm-bindgen JSON-string exports; native builds and tests never enable it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: operation_applier depends on open_pipe_stress_canonical_json (RFC 8785 JCS canonical JSON, the single hash-seam canonicalization), open_pipe_stress_units, serde, serde_json, sha2, and a pinned wasm-bindgen =0.2.123.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The operation_applier crate is the structured editor-operation validation, diff-preview, and apply seam for the desktop app.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: operation_applier is the DEL-16-02 / DEL-16-03 runtime seam: it consumes the UI's structured EditorOperationIntent records, validates them against a model document without mutating it, and produces deterministic diff-preview rows.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Only the apply path returns a new model document with the single validated change applied plus an honest acceptance receipt.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PKG-16 boundary rule: the input model document is never mutated in place.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PKG-16 boundary rule: blocked operations are findings, not silent fallbacks — no invented values, no ungoverned unit conversion, no geometry defaults.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PKG-16 boundary rule: receipts record a user-initiated local-session acceptance basis only, never a professional, certification, sealing, approval, authentication, or code-compliance claim.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: OPERATION_APPLIER_VERSION constant is '0.1.0' and is carried as the outcome schema_version.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: OUTCOME_DOCUMENT_KIND constant is 'openpipestress.desktop.operation_outcome', the document_kind of every OperationOutcome.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: BACKEND_CANONICALIZATION is 'rfc8785_jcs' (RFC 8785 JCS since completion-plan H5: ECMAScript number rendering, UTF-16 key sort, JSON.stringify string escaping), carried in hash evidence.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ENGINE_SOURCE constant is 'core/model_operations/operation_applier', stamped as the source on every diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RESTRAINT_TOKENS is the restraint-direction vocabulary [UX, UY, UZ, RX, RY, RZ] used by preview model documents.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: CANONICAL_DIMENSIONS is the accepted PKG-02 dimension vocabulary (30 tokens) shared by docs/SPEC.md §4, schemas/units.schema.yaml DimensionId, and the DEL-16-02 validation-preview engine.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The canonical dimension set includes dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, temperature_interval, angle, rotation, force, moment, pressure, stress, area, volume, density, linear_stiffness, rotational_stiffness, displacement, velocity, acceleration, thermal_conductivity, specific_heat, thermal_expansion_coefficient, second_moment_area, section_modulus, mass_per_length, volume_per_length, slope, force_per_length, and TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: OutcomeDiagnostic struct carries id, code, severity, message, remediation, affected_refs, and source for each finding.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DiffPreviewRow struct carries entity_ref, object_type, field_path, before, after, unit, dimension, and change_kind for a single previewed change.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ModelBasisEvidence struct carries claimed_model_hash, claimed_hash_canonicalization, backend_model_hash, backend_canonicalization, and binding_status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ValidationStates struct carries schema_validation, reference_validation, unit_validation, before_state_validation, diff_preview_status, and application_status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: AcceptanceRecord struct carries acceptance_basis, acceptance_is_professional_approval (bool), and persistence_status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: OperationOutcome is the top-level result document with schema_version, document_kind, deliverable_refs, mode, application_route, operation_id, change_id, kinds, target, validation, diff_preview, diagnostics, model_basis, input_model_unchanged, applied_model, applied_model_backend_hash, acceptance, audit_boundary, and professional_boundary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: EnteredQuantity holds a user-entered value (f64) and its unit string.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: UnitSource enum distinguishes SiblingUnitField (unit stored next to value as {value,unit}) from ProjectUnits(key) (bare numeric whose unit basis is the project unit-system entry, e.g. node positions use project.units.length).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: FieldKind enum classifies editable fields as Text, Number{require_positive}, Quantity{require_positive,unit_source}, EntityRef{collection}, or RestraintSet.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: FieldKind::Quantity with require_positive rejects non-physical zero/negative geometry and modulus values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: FieldRule pairs a static field_path with its FieldKind, driving per-object-type validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: COMBINATION_BASIS_CLOSED_SET (TP-APP-R2-COMBEXPR-001) is the closed set [mechanics, result_state_subtraction, range_envelope], mirroring core/loads/load_case_algebra::AlgebraExpression vocabulary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Combination basis 'mechanics' is a linear combination over explicit terms; 'result_state_subtraction' is minuend_id minus subtrahend_id; 'range_envelope' is a mode-selected value across operand_ids.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Code/rule and owner-basis combination types remain private/deferred (not in the closed set).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: COMBINATION_RANGE_MODE_TOKENS is the closed set [min, max, min_abs, max_abs], mirroring core/loads/load_case_algebra::RangeMode.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DEFERRED_FIELDS lists inspector-offered fields whose application is deliberately deferred to a later completion-plan item, returned as explicit blocked findings so the scope limit stays visible.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Deferred fields: Component.kind editing is deferred to the component editor scope (Phase C/D), and Combination.terms editing is deferred to the load case manager (A4).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: field_rules(object_type) returns the static FieldRule set for each supported object type (Material, Node, Element, Support, Component, Load, Combination); unknown types get an empty rule set.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Material editable fields are label, provenance, elastic_modulus.value (positive quantity), shear_modulus.value (positive quantity), and thermal_expansion_coefficient.value (sign-unconstrained quantity).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Node editable fields are label, provenance, and position.x/y/z, each a length quantity whose unit basis is project.units.length (sign-unconstrained).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Element editable fields are label, provenance, material (EntityRef into materials), section.outside_diameter.value, and section.wall_thickness.value (positive sibling-unit quantities).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Support editable fields are label, provenance, node (EntityRef into nodes), and restraints (RestraintSet).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Component editable fields are label, provenance, and node (EntityRef into nodes).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Load editable fields are label, status, kind, and provenance (all Text).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Combination editable fields are label, basis, and provenance (all Text).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: collection_for(object_type) maps object types to model collection keys: Material->materials, Node->nodes, Element->pipe_segments, Support->supports, Component->components, Load->load_cases, Combination->combinations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: validate_operation(model, intent, claimed_model_hash) validates a structured editor-operation intent against a model document and never mutates or returns a model.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: apply_operation(model, intent, claimed_model_hash) validates and, when no blocking finding exists, applies the single change to a cloned model document; the input model is never mutated in place.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The wasm_api module is the JSON-string boundary for the wasm32 browser-engine build (--features wasm; DEC-020 / ADR-0001); exports accept and return JSON strings so the JavaScript shim stays a thin transport. Native builds and tests do not compile it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Malformed input JSON to the wasm engine returns a structured error envelope (document_kind openpipestress.desktop.wasm_engine_input_error) instead of trapping — surfaced as an explicit diagnostic, never a silent fallback.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: WASM input-error code is 'WASM-ENGINE-INPUT-JSON-INVALID' with severity 'blocking'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: wasm run_json parses model, intent, and claimed_model_hash JSON; a null claimed_model_hash maps to None.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Honest receipt: outcomes produced through the in-process wasm engine set application_route to 'local_wasm_engine', not the Tauri backend command route.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: canonical_json_string(value_json) canonicalizes a JSON document with the engine's RFC 8785 (JCS) form — the same function the engine uses for model hashes (H1 / F-5a hash seam; the desktop frontend has no canonicalization of its own).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: canonical_sha256_hex(value_json) returns the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the canonical form of a JSON document.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Mode enum has ValidateOnly and Apply variants selecting the run pipeline path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Checker accumulates diagnostics and tracks schema_blocked plus reference_state, unit_state, and before_state (each starting 'not_run').
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Checker.blocking() returns true when any accumulated diagnostic has severity 'blocking'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Checker.push assigns each diagnostic a deterministic id 'diagnostic:operation-applier:{code-lowercased}:{NNN}' and stamps ENGINE_SOURCE as its source.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: run(model, intent, claimed_model_hash, mode) is the core pipeline: it extracts intent fields, runs structure/audit/kind checks, computes model-basis evidence, dispatches per change_kind resolution, builds diff preview, optionally applies on a cloned model, and assembles the OperationOutcome.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: run extracts operation_id, change_id, operation_kind, change_kind, object_type, target_ref, field_path, before, after, unit, and dimension from the intent (with defaults for missing).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Field-level resolution proceeds only for supported structured payloads when schema is not blocked; underspecified viewport gestures are held rather than invented.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: run dispatches resolution by change_kind to dedicated resolvers (modify field, create/delete node, connect/delete pipe run, create section/material/support/load_case, create/delete primitive load, create/delete combination and combination term, delete support).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: On apply with no blocking finding, run clones the model, applies the resolved change, and records applied_model_backend_hash as 'sha256:' + sha256_hex(canonical_json(next_model)).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ValidationStates: schema_validation is 'blocked' or 'passed'; diff_preview_status is 'blocked_by_validation' or 'generated'; application_status is 'not_applied' (validate-only), 'applied_to_session_model' (applied), or 'blocked'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: When applied, acceptance_basis is 'user_initiated_apply_in_local_session' with persistence_status 'session_state_only_not_yet_saved'; otherwise 'none_validation_only' / 'not_applicable_no_application'. acceptance_is_professional_approval is always false.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: run sorts diagnostics deterministically by (code, message) before emitting the outcome.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: OperationOutcome deliverable_refs are ['DEL-16-02','DEL-16-03'] and default application_route is 'tauri_backend_apply'; input_model_unchanged is always true.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: audit_boundary records mutation_route 'structured_operations_only', direct_model_mutation_allowed false, requires_user_acceptance true, input_model_mutated_in_place false, and applied_model_is_new_document.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: professional_boundary records human_review_required true and false for every software compliance, certification, sealing, approval, and authentication claim.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ResolvedField holds the FieldKind, current_display (inspector-style before value), parsed applied_value, path segments inside the entity, and additional sibling writes belonging to the same validated edit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: QuantityEdit holds a parsed value (f64) and unit for a numeric edit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_intent_structure blocks (schema) with OP-INTENT-FIELD-MISSING when any required intent field is absent: operation_id, operation_kind, operation_status, target.object_type, target.ref, change.change_id, change.change_kind, change.field_path, audit_boundary, professional_boundary, and change.before/after/unit/dimension.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_audit_boundary blocks with OP-DIRECT-MUTATION-BLOCKED unless mutation_route is 'structured_operations_only' and direct_model_mutation_allowed is false.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: is_modify_change_kind returns true only for change kinds set_field, update_load, and update_support.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_kinds blocks with OP-KIND-UNSUPPORTED any change_kind outside the structured editor-operation taxonomy.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The supported change-kind taxonomy is set_field, update_load, update_support, create_node, delete_node, connect_pipe_run, delete_pipe_run, create_section, create_material, create_support, create_load_case, delete_load_case, create_primitive_load, delete_primitive_load, create_combination, delete_combination, create_combination_term, delete_support, delete_combination_term, and insert_component_symbol.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_kinds blocks with OP-CHANGE-KIND-MISMATCH when operation_kind does not match the expected kind for the change_kind (modify/create/delete/connect/insert).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: insert_component_symbol is blocked with OP-GEOMETRY-INPUT-INCOMPLETE: the viewport gesture does not yet carry explicit geometry/connectivity inputs and values are not invented on the user's behalf (completion plan A3).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_node requires object_type 'Node' and field_path 'nodes', a 'not_present' before value, present and length-compatible project length unit metadata (DEC-018), an intent length unit, and dimension 'length'; otherwise it emits blocking findings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_node blocks with OP-TARGET-ALREADY-EXISTS when the target node id already exists; create operations never overwrite existing entities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_node requires the after payload to be a JSON object with matching id, non-empty label, non-empty provenance, and finite numeric x/y/z coordinates, converting coordinates to the stored length unit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_delete_node requires object_type 'Node', field_path 'nodes', after-value 'not_present', unit 'none', and dimension 'dimensionless'; it blocks when the node is missing or still referenced by other model entities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_connect_pipe_run resolves an explicit pipe-run connection between existing nodes, validating length-unit geometry and endpoint references.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_delete_pipe_run removes one pipe run only when it is unreferenced (e.g. by primitive loads); it blocks otherwise.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_section validates and builds a new pipe section record from an explicit payload, preserving compatible entered length units and blocking duplicate ids or invalid geometry.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_material validates and builds a new material record, requiring positive modulus quantities and blocking duplicate ids or invalid quantity payloads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_support validates and builds a new support record, blocking duplicate ids and missing node references.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_load_case creates an empty load-case shell only (no primitive loads embedded at creation).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_delete_load_case removes an unreferenced load case only, blocking when combinations still reference it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_primitive_load validates and builds a single primitive load (concentrated/distributed force, concentrated moment, pressure, thermal, or imposed displacement) attached to a load case, preserving compatible entered units.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_combination creates a combination record whose basis is in the closed set, dispatching to mechanics, subtraction, or range-envelope builders.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_combination_payload_shape blocks create payloads carrying fields belonging to a different basis, so applied records always match exactly one closed-set expression shape.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_combination_operand_load_case validates that combination operands reference existing load cases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_mechanics_combination builds a mechanics combination as a linear combination over explicit terms, including an initial term.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_subtraction_combination builds a result_state_subtraction combination as minuend_id minus subtrahend_id.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_range_combination builds a range_envelope combination as a mode-selected value across operand_ids.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_create_combination_term appends exactly one term to a mechanics-basis combination and requires a mechanics-basis target.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_delete_primitive_load removes one indexed primitive load only from its load case.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_delete_combination removes one combination record only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_delete_combination_term removes one indexed term only from a combination.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_delete_support removes one unreferenced support only, blocking when an imposed-displacement load references it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_field resolves a modify-field edit: it blocks with OP-OBJECT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED for unknown object types, then validates the field against its FieldRule (text, number, quantity, entity ref, restraint set) and builds a ResolvedField.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_before validates that the intent's before value matches the current model display (string staleness check), recording before_state.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_before_numeric performs the before-value staleness check numerically rather than by string compare.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: apply_resolved_field writes the parsed value (and any additional sibling writes) into the cloned model at the resolved path segments.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: apply_created_node appends the validated new node to the model's nodes collection.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: apply_deleted_node removes the node from the model's nodes collection by id.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: apply_created_pipe appends the validated new pipe run to the model's pipe_segments collection.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: apply_deleted_pipe removes the pipe run from pipe_segments by id.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: apply_created_section, apply_created_material, apply_created_support, and apply_created_load_case each append the validated new record to its respective collection.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A change_kind outside SUPPORTED_CHANGE_KINDS emits OP-CHANGE-KIND-UNSUPPORTED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A change missing a structured value_payload mapping emits OP-PAYLOAD-MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Quantity-kind payloads require complete value, unit, and dimension metadata, emitting OP-UNIT-METADATA-MISSING when incomplete.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Quantity payloads whose dimension is outside the accepted PKG-02 vocabulary emit OP-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: For remove_object, set_field, move_geometry, and reconnect changes, a target id absent from the entity index emits OP-TARGET-REF-UNRESOLVED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _preview_change computes a deterministic before/after delta: add_object builds an object from payload, remove_object sets after to None, otherwise it patches the existing object, and unresolved targets are blocked_by_validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _blocked_preview emits a preview row with change_kind blocked_by_validation and the sorted blocking diagnostic codes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _entity_index builds an id-keyed map of accepted-state entities, reading from entities or model_state.entities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _patched_object applies structured_values, scalar_values, and quantity_values from the payload as preview overlays on a deep copy of the entity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _direct_mutation_requested flags operations whose validation application_status is outside the allowed set or whose operation_status is agent_accepted_engineering_state or auto_approved.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _quantity_has_units treats a mapping as having units only when it contains value, unit, and dimension keys.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The solver-boundary adapter accepts canonical analytical_solver_model mappings and emits plain deterministic records for lower solver-boundary orchestration; it is not a public API, CLI, preview runtime, or load engine.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The adapter contract id is DEL-13-04-internal-analytical-solver-boundary-adapter-0.1, with axes (X,Y,Z), DOF axes (UX,UY,UZ,RX,RY,RZ), and a vector tolerance of 1.0e-12.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: LOAD_RECORD_CONTRACTS defines four canonical load record types: nodal_force, nodal_moment, element_point_force, and element_uniform_distributed_force, each with required keys, target type, quantity dimension, and direction axes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Material property dimensions require elastic_modulus and shear_modulus as stress; section property dimensions require area, second_moment_y, second_moment_z, and torsion_constant; mass_per_length is optional.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: SolverBoundaryAdapterResult is a frozen dataclass DTO carrying nodes, straight_pipe_connectivity, property_bindings, support_targets, load_case_records, load_applications, adapter_dto_records, and diagnostics.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: SolverBoundaryAdapterResult.has_blocking_findings is True when any diagnostic or load-case diagnostic has severity blocking.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: adapt_analytical_solver_model adapts a strict analytical solver model into deterministic DTO records.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A non-mapping analytical model input emits blocking ASBA-SOURCE-MODEL-MISSING and returns an empty result.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An analytical model whose model_role is not analytical_solver_model emits blocking ASBA-SOURCE-ROLE-UNEXPECTED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _adapt_nodes requires id, coordinates, and degrees_of_freedom, emits ASBA-NODE-DOF-UNRESOLVED when any DOF axis is None/empty/TBD, and adapts each node into indexed coordinate values, units, and quantities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _adapt_straight_pipes requires straight_pipe elements with resolvable start/end node, material, section, and a canonical cartesian local_coordinate_system; non-straight-pipe types emit ASBA-ELEMENT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Straight-pipe connectivity requires an explicit cartesian local coordinate system; absence emits ASBA-ELEMENT-LOCAL-COORDINATE-SYSTEM-UNSUPPORTED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The local_coordinate_system must contain exactly type, axes, y_reference, and provenance; extra keys emit ASBA-ELEMENT-LOCAL-COORDINATE-SYSTEM-NONCANONICAL.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Local axes other than canonical X/Y/Z emit ASBA-ELEMENT-LOCAL-AXES-UNSUPPORTED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An adapted straight pipe records derived_axis_x from start/end coordinates, the y_reference vector, and solver_orientation_status governed_y_reference_ready.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _adapt_property_bindings binds each straight pipe to its required material and section quantity properties plus optional section properties, producing a BIND-STRAIGHT-PIPE binding record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _adapt_supports requires id, support_type, target_ref, directions, and properties; directions must be explicit DOF axes (ASBA-SUPPORT-DIRECTIONS-UNSUPPORTED) and the target must resolve to an adapted node or element (ASBA-SUPPORT-TARGET-UNRESOLVED).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _adapt_load_cases validates each load case and its loads, emitting load applications only for fully canonical resolvable loads and marking the load case solver_ready only when all loads emit with no diagnostics.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A load record_type not in the canonical union emits ASBA-LOAD-RECORD-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED, and noncanonical extra keys emit ASBA-LOAD-NONCANONICAL-SEMANTICS-UNSUPPORTED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Each load's quantity must match the contract quantity dimension and its direction must be in the contract direction axes (ASBA-LOAD-DIRECTION-UNSUPPORTED).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: element_point_force loads require a dimensionless station_fraction quantity; element_uniform_distributed_force loads require a validated span.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _orientation_diagnostics validates that a finite nonzero local X axis exists and that y_reference is three finite numeric components, nonzero, and not parallel to the derived X axis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _derived_axis_x returns the normalized direction vector between two 3D coordinate lists, or None when the separation length is within tolerance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _span requires start_fraction and end_fraction dimensionless quantities, both in [0,1] with start_fraction < end_fraction, emitting span range and order diagnostics since JSON Schema cannot compare sibling values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _norm computes the Euclidean norm and _cross computes the 3D vector cross product.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _adapter_dto_identity_records builds a sorted DTO identity record per load application with a JCS sha256 payload_hash and a two-step source_chain from analytical model to adapter DTO to solver input.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _stable_payload_hash computes a sha256 hex digest over the JSON-encoded value with sorted keys, compact separators, and allow_nan=False.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _quantity validates a canonical Quantity requiring value, unit, dimension, and provenance, a finite numeric value, explicit non-TBD unit/dimension, and a matching expected dimension, with a distinct diagnostic per failure.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The adapter does not convert or infer units and does not reinterpret dimensions; a quantity dimension mismatch emits a DIMENSION-UNSUPPORTED diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _ref builds an object reference mapping of object_type and id with spaces replaced by hyphens.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The adapter _diagnostic record carries code, class (SOLVE_BLOCKING or ASSUMPTION_WARNING), severity, source, affected_object, message, and remediation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The physical-to-analytical transform contract derives a solver-oriented centerline/frame model from a supplied physical source model and is provider-neutral.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Incomplete or non-representable inputs become deterministic diagnostics instead of inferred engineering defaults.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Centerline element types are straight_pipe, frame, and rigid; supported analytical metadata component types are rigid, valve, flange, reducer, and specialty.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Supported support types are anchor, guide, line_stop, restraint, spring, gap, and friction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: TransformSettings carries stable analytical_model_id, analytical_model_name, and contract_version DEL-13-04-0.1 into deterministic output identity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: TransformResult carries the analytical_model, diagnostics, and traceability_links, with has_blocking_findings True when any diagnostic severity is blocking.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: transform_physical_to_analytical derives a deterministic analytical model from a physical source model without mutating the source; non-representable records are omitted with traceable diagnostics.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A non-mapping physical model input emits blocking PTA-SOURCE-MODEL-MISSING and returns an empty analytical model.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A physical model whose model_role is not physical_source_of_truth emits the warning PTA-SOURCE-ROLE-UNEXPECTED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A missing or TBD coordinate_system emits blocking PTA-COORDINATE-SYSTEM-MISSING; the transform does not infer a coordinate system.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The derived analytical model has model_role analytical_solver_model and carries nodes, elements, components, materials, sections, supports, load_cases, combinations, stable diagnostics, and traceability links.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _copy_nodes requires id, coordinates, and degrees_of_freedom with resolved unit and DOF gaps; an absent or empty node list emits blocking PTA-NODES-MISSING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _copy_records_with_units copies materials and sections only when their quantity-bearing fields have resolved unit metadata, emitting unit gap diagnostics otherwise.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classify_components requires id, component_type, geometry, mechanics_modifiers, and provenance; unsupported component types emit the warning PTA-COMPONENT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED and are excluded.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _copy_elements validates element fields and references, blocking on unresolved node/material/section refs and on component_ref that does not resolve to a supported analytical metadata component (PTA-ELEMENT-COMPONENT-UNSUPPORTED).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An element_type outside the centerline/frame types emits the warning PTA-ELEMENT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED unless it is a component_link to a known component.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _copy_supports validates support fields and target references and emits PTA-SUPPORT-TYPE-UNSUPPORTED for support types outside the supported set.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _copy_load_cases validates load case fields and each load's target reference and quantity units, blocking on unresolved targets or unit gaps.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _quantity_gaps recursively inspects unit-bearing values, emitting a unit diagnostic for missing/TBD unit or dimension and PTA-UNIT-DIMENSION-UNKNOWN for dimensions outside the accepted PKG-02 vocabulary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _dof_gaps requires a degrees_of_freedom mapping with explicit non-TBD states for all six DOF axes, emitting PTA-NODE-DOF-MISSING or PTA-NODE-DOF-UNRESOLVED; no restraint defaults are inferred.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _reference_gap emits a blocking SOLVE_BLOCKING diagnostic when a referenced record id is missing or not present among known ids.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _trace_link builds a physical_to_analytical traceability link from source to target (or to a synthesized Diagnostic target) with provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _stable_traceability deterministically orders links and attaches the matching diagnostic to links whose target object_type is Diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The contract _ref coerces object_type to TBD unless it is one of the known types Project, Model, Node, Element, Component, Material, Section, Support, LoadCase, Combination, or Diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The open_pipe_stress_product_physics crate (version 0.1.0, edition 2021, publish=false) is the product-preview physics adapter for OpenPipeStress.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: product_physics depends on the frame_kernel, load_case_algebra, linear_supports, primitive_loads, straight_pipe, stress_recovery, and units crates plus serde and serde_json.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The product_physics preview_result example loads the invented_preview_model.json fixture into a PreviewModel.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The preview example runs run_linear_static_preview with an empty materials list and prints the pretty-printed JSON result.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Crate core/product_physics is a product-preview physics adapter mapping invented public preview-model data into the code-neutral mechanics crates.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The physics adapter emits mechanics quantities and diagnostics only; it does not encode standards criteria, allowables, SIF tables, private data, or professional acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PreviewModel is the deserialized preview input: schema_version, document_kind, project, analysis_status, nodes, pipe_segments, supports, materials, load_cases, and combinations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: StatusEnvelope carries three status strings: mechanics, rule_check, and professional_acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PreviewNode has an id, a position (Vec3), and optional provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Vec3 is a 3D coordinate with f64 x, y, z fields.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PreviewPipe references from-node and to-node ids, a section, a material id, an optional y_reference orientation vector, and optional provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PipeSectionInput specifies outside_diameter and wall_thickness as unit-bearing Quantity values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Quantity is a unit-bearing scalar with an f64 value and a unit string.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PreviewSupport has an id, a node reference, a list of restraint DOF strings, an optional family, optional stiffness input, and optional provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PreviewLoadCase has an id, a list of primitive_loads, and optional provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PreviewCombination has an id, optional label, a basis string, terms, and optional minuend_id, subtrahend_id, operand_ids, mode, and provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The combination basis is a closed set: mechanics (linear terms), result_state_subtraction (minuend minus subtrahend), and range_envelope (mode over operand_ids); vocabulary mirrors AlgebraExpression.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PreviewCombinationTerm pairs a load_case id with an f64 factor.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PreviewPrimitiveLoad has id, category, target, direction, magnitude (Quantity), dimension, and optional provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: LoadTargetInput is a tagged enum selecting either a Node target or an Element (pipe) target.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: MaterialInput carries id, elastic_modulus, shear_modulus, optional thermal_expansion_coefficient, and optional provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: LinearStaticPreviewRequest wraps a PreviewModel plus an optional materials list.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: MechanicsEnvelope is the emitted result: schema_version, document_kind, run_id, model_ref, status, summary, results, diagnostics, professional_boundary, and accepted_model_state_mutated.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Summary reports node_count, segment_count, support_count, load_case_count, and optional max_displacement and max_open_formula_stress.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: LocatedQuantity is a value with unit, a location_ref, and a result_ref.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ResultItem is a single result row: id, kind, value, unit, entity_ref, optional basis_ref, source_result_refs, and optional metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ResultBasisRef pairs a ref_type with a ref_id.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ResultMetadata records component, coordinate_system, location, basis, and sign_convention for a result row.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Diagnostic is a finding row: id, code, severity, message, optional source, and affected_refs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ProfessionalBoundary flags human_review_required and four software-claim booleans for compliance, certification, sealing, and approval.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DerivedSection holds computed pipe section properties: area, internal_area, second_moment, torsion_constant, section_modulus, torsion_radius, membrane_radius, and wall_thickness.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: run_linear_static_preview is the public entry point that validates inputs, normalizes units, builds the model, applies boundary conditions, solves each load case, and assembles the MechanicsEnvelope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: When request.materials is empty the adapter falls back to the model's own materials list.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The adapter requires document_kind to equal openpipestress.product_preview.model, else emits a blocking PREVIEW_DOCUMENT_KIND_INVALID diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An empty schema_version yields a blocking PREVIEW_SCHEMA_VERSION_MISSING diagnostic; the preview model requires an explicit schema version.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: If any blocking diagnostic is present the adapter returns a blocked envelope rather than solving.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Linear-static preview requires explicit support restraints or springs; with no restraints and no springs a blocking SUPPORT_INPUT_MISSING diagnostic is emitted and no automatic boundary conditions are applied.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Fewer than six rigid restraints (DOF_PER_NODE) yields a blocking SOLVER_SYSTEM_BLOCKED under-restrained diagnostic naming restrained, missing, and per-support DOF contributions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Boundary-preparation findings are surfaced as blocking SUPPORT_INPUT_INVALID diagnostics keyed by support id.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Global stiffness is assembled from the frame elements; assembly failure returns a solver-blocked envelope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Spring supports add their stiffness value to the diagonal of the global stiffness matrix at the spring's global DOF index.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Each load case is solved independently; a frame-kernel error during a load-case solve returns a solver-blocked envelope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Summary max_displacement and max_stress are taken from the first (default) load-case solve.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Result rows are indexed by base id and load-case id; non-default load cases get qualified result ids and a load_case basis_ref.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A computed max displacement exceeding 5.0 (invented review threshold) emits a HIGH_DISPLACEMENT_REVIEW warning diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The adapter always appends a RULE_CHECK_INPUTS_MISSING warning: rule-check inputs and protected criteria are absent, so no compliance result is produced.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A solved MechanicsEnvelope sets document_kind openpipestress.product_preview.mechanics_result, schema_version 0.1.0, mechanics status MECHANICS_SOLVED, rule_check RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE, and professional_acceptance NOT_PROVIDED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A successful preview run leaves accepted_model_state_mutated false; the adapter does not mutate accepted model state.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: solve_load_case builds primitive loads, prepares the load application, assembles the force vector, reduces and solves the linear system, and recovers displacements, reactions, forces, and stresses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Load-application findings are surfaced as blocking LOAD_INPUT_INVALID diagnostics keyed by load id and load-case id.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Thermal element loads and pressure-thrust loads are derived and added to the force vector alongside uniform element loads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The reduced system is solved with reduce_system and solve_dense; reduced displacements are scattered back into the full free-DOF displacement vector.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Per-node displacement magnitude is computed and reported in millimetres, tracking the maximum displacement across nodes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Support reactions are computed as internal minus applied force (K*u - f) and reported as a reaction resultant magnitude in newtons over the support's restrained DOFs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Per-pipe element local forces are recovered from the global solution; recovery failure emits a warning ELEMENT_FORCE_RECOVERY_FAILED diagnostic and skips the element.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Recovered local forces are corrected for thermal and pressure-thrust axial effects before force and stress results are appended.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Force and stress results are produced at endpoints (end_i, end_j) and at interpolated stations along the element.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: When pressure thrust is active the pressure longitudinal stress component is excluded from the open-formula stress (include_pressure_longitudinal is false).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Stress-recovery findings emit warning STRESS_RECOVERY_LIMITED diagnostics; endpoint and station stress results are only appended when their findings are empty.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The per-element open_formula_stress_summary is the maximum open-formula stress (in MPa) across endpoints and stations, tracked as the load case max stress.

UnitStatement: normalize_model_units converts material moduli, thermal expansion coefficient, pipe diameter and wall thickness, support stiffness, and load magnitudes to their canonical solver units.

UnitStatement: A non-finite load magnitude emits a blocking LOAD_MAGNITUDE_INVALID diagnostic; load magnitude must be finite.

UnitStatement: A load targeting an unknown node emits a blocking LOAD_NODE_UNKNOWN diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A load targeting an unknown pipe emits a blocking LOAD_PIPE_UNKNOWN diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An unsupported load category, direction, or dimension emits a blocking LOAD_INPUT_INVALID diagnostic.

UnitStatement: derive_pipe_section validates outside diameter and wall thickness, requiring explicit positive values with wall thickness less than radius, else emits a blocking PIPE_DIMENSION_INVALID diagnostic.

UnitStatement: Inside diameter is computed as outside diameter minus twice the wall thickness (id = od - 2*t).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Pipe cross-sectional area is PI*(od^2 - id^2)/4.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Pipe internal (bore) area is PI*id^2/4.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Pipe second moment of area is PI*(od^4 - id^4)/64.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Pipe torsion constant is twice the second moment of area (2*I).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Pipe section modulus is the second moment of area divided by the outer radius (I/(od/2)).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Torsion radius is the outer radius od/2; membrane radius is (od - t)/2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: add_uniform_element_loads distributes element uniform loads equally to the two end nodes (half the magnitude times length to each end), skipping pressure and temperature-change dimensions.

UnitStatement: build_thermal_element_loads computes an equivalent axial load E*A*alpha*deltaT for thermal temperature-change loads on elements with a defined thermal expansion coefficient.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: build_pressure_thrust_loads computes a pressure-thrust axial load as pressure magnitude times the internal (bore) area for pressure-dimension element loads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: add_pressure_thrust_loads applies the pressure-thrust axial load along the element local x axis, subtracting at node i and adding at node j.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: add_thermal_equivalent_loads applies the thermal equivalent axial load along the element local x axis, subtracting at node i and adding at node j.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: corrected_local_forces_for_axial_effects adds the summed thermal and pressure-thrust axial load into the recovered local axial force at both element ends.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Station resultants are evaluated at three interior locations: quarter_1 (0.25), midspan (0.5), and quarter_3 (0.75) along the element.

UnitStatement: Station resultants are linearly interpolated between end_i and end_j resultants by the station fraction.

UnitStatement: Per-node displacement components (ux, uy, uz in mm; rx, ry, rz in rad) are reported in the global coordinate system with explicit sign conventions.

UnitStatement: Element force and moment results (axial, shear-y, shear-z in N; torsion, bending-y, bending-z in N*m) are reported at each endpoint in the element-local coordinate system.

UnitStatement: recover_endpoint_stress recovers stress components from endpoint force resultants, section properties, and optional pressure basis via recover_stresses.

UnitStatement: recover_station_stress recovers stress components from interpolated station resultants, section properties, and optional pressure basis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The open-formula stress summary (MPa) is the larger absolute extreme-fibre normal stress: max(|base_normal + bending_total|, |base_normal - bending_total|), where base_normal = axial + pressure-longitudinal and bending_total = |bending_y| + |bending_z|.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Endpoint stress results report axial-normal, bending-normal-y, bending-normal-z, and torsional-shear components, plus pressure hoop and longitudinal stresses when pressure is present.

UnitStatement: Frozen scope: n-ary min/max over same-dimension, same-unit quantities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The evaluator accepts structured expression data only; interpolation/lookup mechanisms are public but table values are user value-slots and never repository content.

UnitStatement: The evaluator declares its own Dimension enum (closed canonical dimension vocabulary) used for expression typing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: AnalysisStatus enum enumerates the analysis statuses the evaluator preserves across evaluation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: BindingSource enum classifies the origin of a variable binding (e.g., solver result vs user-supplied value).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Quantity struct represents a value with dimension and unit-reference metadata; Quantity::new validates inputs and Quantity::dimensionless builds a dimensionless quantity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: VariableBinding struct binds a variable_id to a source and quantity; VariableBinding::new and VariableBinding::missing construct present and missing bindings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: UnaryOperator enum is Negate, Abs, Not.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: BinaryOperator enum is Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: LogicalOperator enum is And, Or.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: AggregateFunction enum is Min, Max.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: LookupMode enum is Exact (argument must exactly equal a row argument; in-range misses are blocking TableKeyNotFound) and Step (largest row argument <= lookup argument applies; out-of-range arguments are blocking TableOutOfRange, never clamped).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: TableRow struct is one user-supplied table row with an argument and result f64; values are user value-slots, not repository content.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: UserTable struct holds table_id, argument_dimension, argument_unit_ref, result_dimension, result_unit_ref, and rows; row arguments must be strictly increasing and out-of-range arguments are blocking (no extrapolation, no clamping).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ComparisonOperator enum is LessThan, LessThanOrEqual, GreaterThan, GreaterThanOrEqual, Equal, NotEqual.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Expression enum is the typed AST: Literal, VariableRef, Unary, Binary, Compare, Logical, Select, Aggregate, Interpolate, Lookup, UnsupportedForm, and UnsafeHostAccess.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Logical expressions evaluate eagerly: both operands are always evaluated so diagnostics in either operand always surface.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Select is an eager conditional evaluating condition, then-branch, and else-branch in fixed order so diagnostics in the unselected branch still block; branches must both be booleans or both quantities of the same dimension with matching unit references.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Aggregate computes n-ary min/max over same-dimension, same-unit quantities, evaluating operands left to right with at least one operand required.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Interpolate performs piecewise-linear interpolation over a user-supplied monotone table of at least two rows; arguments outside the closed row-argument range are blocking findings (no extrapolation, no clamping).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Lookup performs exact or step lookup over a user-supplied monotone table.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: EvaluationValue enum is either a Quantity or a Boolean.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: FindingCode enum enumerates evaluator finding codes: UnsafeConstruct, UnsupportedExpressionForm, MissingVariable, DuplicateBinding, InvalidReference, MissingRequiredValue, NonFiniteInput, DivisionByZero, UnitMetadataMissing, UnitMismatch, DimensionMismatch, TypeMismatch, StatusBoundaryViolation, UnsupportedGrammarVersion, TableMalformed, TableOutOfRange, and TableKeyNotFound.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: UnsupportedGrammarVersion finding is always blocking (RULE_EVALUATOR_ERROR class); the evaluator never falls back to best-effort evaluation on a missing, malformed, or unsupported declared grammar version.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: EvaluationFinding struct records a finding (code, severity, subject, message) produced during evaluation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: EvaluationInput struct carries the expression, variable bindings, current statuses, and the rule pack's declared grammar_version, which must be in SUPPORTED_GRAMMAR_VERSIONS or evaluation blocks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: EvaluationResult struct holds the evaluation outcome; is_blocked reports whether evaluation was blocked.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: EvaluationError enum models internal value-construction errors (e.g., non-finite input) used by Quantity construction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: evaluate(input) is the public entry point: it checks grammar version, builds the binding map, validates required variables, evaluates the expression, and collects statuses into an EvaluationResult.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: build_binding_map indexes variable bindings by id and emits a blocking DuplicateBinding finding for repeated variable ids.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_required_variables verifies that referenced variables are bound and emits MissingVariable/MissingRequiredValue findings as appropriate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: eval_expression recursively evaluates an Expression node, dispatching to unary, binary, compare, logical, select, aggregate, and table handlers.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: eval_select evaluates condition, then-branch, and else-branch eagerly so diagnostics in the unselected branch still surface and block.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: eval_aggregate evaluates n-ary min/max over same-dimension same-unit operands left to right.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: validate_table pushes findings in fixed order (id, unit metadata, row count, per-row finiteness, monotonicity) to keep the diagnostic stream deterministic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: eval_table_expression is the shared path for Interpolate (mode None) and Lookup (mode Some): table structure is validated first, then the argument is evaluated, with findings surfacing in that fixed order.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DIMENSION_PRODUCTS is the enumerated dimension-product table over the closed Dimension enum; each commutative (factor_a, factor_b, product) entry defines a unit-free dimensional mechanics relation, and products not in the table are blocking UnsupportedExpressionForm findings with no silent enum extension or fallback to Tbd.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DIMENSION_PRODUCTS encodes mechanics relations including Length*Length=Area, Area*Length=Volume, Force*Length=Moment, Pressure*Area=Force, Stress*Area=Force, Mass*Acceleration=Force, and Density*Volume=Mass.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DIMENSION_PRODUCTS further encodes MassPerLength*Length=Mass, VolumePerLength*Length=Volume, LinearStiffness*Length=Force, LinearStiffness*Displacement=Force, RotationalStiffness*Angle=Moment, and RotationalStiffness*Rotation=Moment.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DIMENSION_PRODUCTS further encodes Stress*SectionModulus=Moment, SectionModulus*Length=SecondMomentArea, Velocity*Time=Length, Acceleration*Time=Velocity, and ThermalExpansionCoefficient*TemperatureInterval=Dimensionless.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: dimension_product(left, right) resolves the commutative product of two non-dimensionless dimensions against the enumerated DIMENSION_PRODUCTS table, returning None when unrepresentable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DimensionQuotient enum represents quotient resolution, including an Ambiguous case when more than one enumerated dimension satisfies candidate x denominator = numerator (the closed enum keeps Pressure and Stress distinct).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: dimension_quotient(numerator, denominator) resolves division by inverting DIMENSION_PRODUCTS, finding the unique dimension c with c x denominator = numerator.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: derived_product_unit_ref composes the canonical unit reference for a product: dimensionless results reuse the ratio token, otherwise operand unit refs are joined with * in lexicographic byte order so multiplication stays commutative; refs are composed, never converted.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: derived_quotient_unit_ref composes the canonical unit reference for a quotient as numerator_ref/denominator_ref (order-preserving).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: multiply combines two quantities using dimension_product and derived_product_unit_ref, blocking when the product is unrepresentable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: divide combines two quantities using dimension_quotient and derived_quotient_unit_ref, emitting DivisionByZero and ambiguity findings as needed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: eval_compare evaluates the six comparison operators over compatible-dimension, matching-unit quantities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: check_grammar_version emits a blocking UnsupportedGrammarVersion finding when the declared version is missing, malformed, or not supported.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: is_semver enforces strict MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH: three dot-separated decimal components, no signs, no leading zeros, and no pre-release/build suffixes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: collect_statuses gathers preserved analysis statuses from the evaluation input into the result.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: quantity_has_required_metadata checks that a quantity carries the unit metadata required for evaluation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: quantity_units_match returns whether two quantities share matching unit references.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: validate_finite returns an EvaluationError when a value is not finite, preventing NaN/inf from entering quantities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: conformance_corpus.rs is the golden conformance corpus runner for the frozen rule-pack expression grammar (DEC-022 / D-02 Option A, tranche TP-C1-GRAMMAR-001).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The corpus runner executes every case_*.json file under fixtures/rule_expressions/conformance_corpus/ through evaluate and asserts the recorded expected outcome exactly: value (exact f64 equality on canonical outputs), ordered (code, subject_id) findings, resulting statuses, and sorted source variable ids.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The corpus is the freeze artifact for grammar version GRAMMAR_VERSION: a grammar change without a corresponding corpus extension fails review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The corpus JSON reader is a test-harness-only strict panic-on-malformed ASCII JSON subset with no dependencies; the evaluator crate itself still does not parse text since rule-pack expressions reach it as structured ASTs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Corpus boundary: all corpus data is invented (PUBLIC_DOMAIN_OR_ORIGINAL) with no protected standards content and no compliance/certification/approval claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: REQUIRED_ACCEPT_FEATURES enforces a coverage floor requiring every grammar feature (literals, variable_ref, all unary/binary/compare/logical operators, select, aggregate min/max, interpolate, lookup exact/step) to appear in at least one accepting finding-free case.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Crate open_pipe_stress_rule_check_runner (version 0.1.0, edition 2021) provides end-to-end rule-check orchestration (C4): completeness, frozen-grammar formula decode and evaluation, ratio-vs-limit acceptability composition, per-check status, and worst-of aggregation over a rule-pack document plus caller-resolved solver and user values, with no text parsing, network/host/filesystem access, protected content, or compliance claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: rule_check_runner depends on open_pipe_stress_expression_evaluator, open_pipe_stress_completeness_checker, open_pipe_stress_rule_pack_document, open_pipe_stress_units, serde, and serde_json.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Crate rule_check_runner provides end-to-end rule-check orchestration for user-owned rule packs (completion plan C4 — end-to-end rule checks on authored models).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The runner wires three engine crates into one runnable path: the completeness checker (required inputs present), the rule_pack_document codec (decode the frozen-grammar formula AST), and the expression evaluator (compute the formula and the acceptability comparison).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.
