CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The runner is pure in-memory orchestration: it does not parse text, execute host-language code, access files or network, spawn processes, load plugins, store private data, embed protected standards content, or emit professional/certification/sealing/authentication/approval/code-compliance claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Acceptability composition: a check whose formula evaluates to a boolean uses that boolean directly as the acceptability predicate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A check whose formula evaluates to a quantity (e.g. a ratio) is compared against the single user-supplied limit named by the check's value_slot_refs, via a synthesized Compare(formula, relation, limit) evaluated through the same evaluator.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Before the evaluator boundary, B2/B3 unit normalization converts compatible DEC-018 catalog units to the declaration's unit; exact non-catalog demonstration units remain valid only when entered and declared unit strings match; incompatible or unknown unit substitutions block rather than evaluating.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The acceptability relation is the check's optional acceptability_relation member (TP-C4-ACCEPTREL-001), one of four ordering relations less_than/less_than_or_equal/greater_than/greater_than_or_equal, defaulting to less_than_or_equal when absent (backward compatible).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An explicit but unrecognized acceptability_relation token blocks the check rather than defaulting silently; the member is an additive PROPOSAL awaiting human ratification, and equality acceptance is a deliberate non-goal.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Input binding is a C4-defined minimal mechanism: the schema carries no selector tying a solver_result required input to a solved result row, so the binding is caller-supplied.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A private_library_value input with no resolved library binding stays unsupplied (never a silent pass) with a recorded note; the library value is resolved at run time and never embedded in the rule pack (IP boundary).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DOCUMENT_KIND is the document-kind tag on a serialized run result: 'openpipestress.rule_check.run'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_NOTICE is carried on every run result: software rule-check evidence only; not a professional, certification, sealing, authentication, approval, or code-compliance claim; human review remains required.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct SolverResultBinding represents one solver value the caller resolved from a solved mechanics envelope for a solver_result required input (fields input_id, result_id, value, unit).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct SuppliedValueBinding represents one user-entered value for a user_supplied_rule_value required input or a value_slot limit; dimension is the snake_case dimension token (fields ref_id, value, unit, dimension).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct LibraryValueBinding represents one value the caller resolved from a saved private library for a private_library_value required input; the value is never embedded in the rule pack and stays in the private library (IP boundary).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct RuleCheckRunInput carries inputs to a rule-check run: rule_pack_document, solver_results, supplied_values, library_values, and current analysis statuses; the caller is expected to have already run document validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Enum RuleCheckStatus is the three automatic rule-check statuses the runner may emit (RuleInputsIncomplete, UserRuleChecked, UserRuleFailed); MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED, and HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT are intentionally not producible here.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RuleCheckStatus::as_str maps each status variant to its canonical screaming-snake-case string token.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RuleCheckStatus::severity_rank defines worst-of precedence: failed (2) > incomplete (1) > checked (0).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct ComputedQuantity is a computed or limit quantity surfaced in a check outcome (fields value, dimension, unit_ref).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct BoundInput records what a single rule-pack input resolved to for a check (input_id, source_kind, supplied flag, optional value/unit/result_id/note).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct RunFinding is a finding surfaced from completeness or evaluation, traced to its engine (fields code, severity, subject_id, message).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct CheckOutcome is the outcome of one check_definition, carrying check_id, status, optional computed_value and limit_value, the governing acceptability_relation, bound_inputs, completeness/evaluator findings, and diagnostic_codes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct RuleCheckRunResult is the result of a run over all of a pack's checks (document_kind, rule_pack_id, grammar_version, aggregate_status, checks, professional_boundary_notice).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function run_rule_checks runs every check_definition in the rule pack against the caller-resolved values and returns per-check outcomes plus a worst-of aggregate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: run_rule_checks collects per-check outcomes by mapping run_one_check over the document's check_definitions array.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: When a pack has no checks, the aggregate status is RuleInputsIncomplete; otherwise it is the worst-of reduction over each check's status by severity_rank.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct RunContext holds the per-run indices (required_inputs, value_slots, formula_declarations) and the caller-supplied binding maps (solver_by_input, supplied_by_ref, library_by_input) plus current_statuses and grammar_version.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct ResolvedValue is a value resolved for a required input, ready to bind into the evaluator (value, unit, eval_dimension, binding_source).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function run_one_check resolves a single check: its check_id, declared result_statuses, and diagnostic_policy, then resolves required inputs, runs completeness, decodes and evaluates the formula, and composes acceptability.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: When a check references an input id absent from the required_index, run_one_check pushes a blocking INVALID_REFERENCE completeness finding ('check references an undeclared required input') and skips it.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Each required input's supplied value is resolved per source kind: SolverResult from solver_by_input, PrivateLibraryValue from library_by_input, UserSuppliedRuleValue from supplied_by_ref, and any other kind falls back to supplied_by_ref.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A resolved private_library_value records a provenance note naming the library kind/id, record, and slot, and states the value stays in the private library and is never embedded in the rule pack.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An unresolved private_library_value records a note that it has no resolved library reference (missing library_value_ref or the library/record/slot was not found) and is treated as unsupplied.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Each supplied value is normalized to the declared unit via normalize_value_to_declared_unit; a normalization error pushes an evaluator finding and leaves the value/unit unset.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A supplied value with a known dimension passes the completeness gates via the private-reviewed constructor; otherwise the input is left unsupplied so completeness blocks (never a silent pass).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: run_one_check runs check_completeness over the assembled required and supplied inputs plus the current statuses, mapping each completeness finding into a RunFinding.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: If completeness readiness is Blocked or any blocking completeness finding exists, the check returns RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with a missing_input diagnostic and acceptability_relation 'none', without evaluating the formula.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The formula is resolved from the formula_index by the check's formula_ref ref_id; an undeclared formula pushes a blocking INVALID_REFERENCE finding and blocks after completeness.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A formula declaration with no declaration_payload.expression_ast pushes a blocking INVALID_REFERENCE finding and blocks after completeness.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The expression AST is decoded via decode_expression; a decode error pushes a blocking DECODE_ERROR finding and blocks after completeness.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The formula's variable references are bound to resolved values; a resolved value with a known eval_dimension binds a Quantity, otherwise it binds a missing VariableBinding (never a silent substitution).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The formula is computed by evaluate over the EvaluationInput (expression, bindings, required_variable_ids, current statuses, declared grammar version); any evaluator finding blocks after completeness.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: When the formula evaluates to a Boolean, true yields USER_RULE_CHECKED and false yields USER_RULE_FAILED, with acceptability_relation 'formula_predicate'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: When the formula evaluates to a Quantity, the top-level acceptability relation is resolved (computed relation limit); an unsupported acceptability_relation token pushes a blocking RULE_EVALUATOR_ERROR and returns RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with relation 'none'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: For a quantity check, the limit is resolved via resolve_limit; a resolution error or absent limit returns RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE (with RULE_INPUT_MISSING when no user-supplied value-slot limit is available).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The limit quantity is built from the limit value, unit, and dimension; missing or unknown unit/dimension metadata pushes a blocking RULE_EVALUATOR_ERROR and returns RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The acceptability comparison evaluates Expression::Compare(operator, formula_quantity, limit_quantity) through the same evaluator; Boolean true yields USER_RULE_CHECKED, false yields USER_RULE_FAILED, otherwise RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function resolve_limit resolves a check's governing limit from the first value_slot_refs entry, taking the numeric value from the caller's supplied-value map keyed by slot id, and returns (value, unit, eval_dimension).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_limit prefers the value_slot's declared dimension and unit_ref from the value_slot_index, falling back to the binding's dimension/unit, then normalizes the value to the declared unit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function normalize_value_to_declared_unit returns the value unchanged when entered and declared unit strings match; missing declared/entered unit metadata or a 'TBD' declared unit yields a blocking UnitMismatch finding.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: normalize_value_to_declared_unit resolves the dimension and the entered/declared unit symbols and converts via convert_for_dimension; an unknown dimension, incompatible unit, or failed conversion yields a blocking UnitMismatch finding.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function unit_mismatch_finding builds a blocking UnitMismatch RunFinding describing that an entered unit cannot be normalized to the declared unit for the given dimension, with a reason.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function resolve_acceptability_relation resolves a check's acceptability relation (computed relation limit) to a frozen-grammar comparison operator.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An absent acceptability_relation member resolves to LessThanOrEqual, preserving historical behaviour for packs authored before the additive member existed (the sole documented default).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: An explicit but unrecognized acceptability_relation token is never silently defaulted; resolve_acceptability_relation returns Err(token) so the caller blocks the check (no-silent-defaults, CONTRACT).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: resolve_acceptability_relation maps tokens less_than, less_than_or_equal, greater_than, greater_than_or_equal to their operators; empty string maps to LessThanOrEqual; any other token returns Err.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function acceptability_relation_label gives the canonical string label for an acceptability relation operator, reported on the check outcome so the GUI shows the governing relation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function quantity_to_computed converts an evaluator Quantity into a ComputedQuantity, encoding the dimension to its document token and copying value and unit_ref.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function blocked_after_completeness returns a RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE CheckOutcome with an evaluator_error diagnostic and acceptability_relation 'none' for checks that block after completeness passed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function enforce_declared keeps an emitted status inside the check's declared result_statuses envelope; an undeclared status is downgraded to RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with a blocking STATUS_NOT_DECLARED finding.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function push_diagnostic appends a diagnostic code resolved from the check's diagnostic_policy for a given key, de-duplicating already-present codes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function index_by builds a HashMap from an array member of the document keyed by each item's id field.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function source_kind_from_token maps source-kind tokens (solver_result, model_input, user_supplied_rule_value, private_library_value, owner_design_basis) to SourceKind, defaulting unknown tokens to Tbd.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function required_for_from_token maps required-for tokens (rule_check, reporting, diagnostic) to RequiredFor, defaulting unknown tokens to Tbd.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function severity_str maps a FindingSeverity (Info, Warning, Blocking) to its lowercase string.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function to_automatic_status maps an evaluator AnalysisStatus to a completeness AutomaticAnalysisStatus; HumanApprovedForProject maps to HumanReviewRequired.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function completeness_dimension_from_token maps a snake_case dimension token to the completeness checker's dimension by routing through the document codec's evaluator-dimension decode (single source of truth for the token vocabulary).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function eval_dimension_to_completeness maps each evaluator Dimension variant to the corresponding completeness Dimension variant.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: rule_check_runner unit tests use a minimal invented rule pack (one ratio check actual/limit against a ratio limit value slot); all values are invented non-engineering content.
Test passing_check_yields_user_rule_checked: ratio 0.5 with default relation yields USER_RULE_CHECKED with a dimensionless ratio computed value and no findings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test failing_check_yields_user_rule_failed: ratio 1.5 yields USER_RULE_FAILED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test missing_solver_input_blocks_without_evaluating: a missing solver binding yields RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with no computed value, relation 'none', and a RULE_INPUT_MISSING diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test missing_limit_slot_blocks_as_incomplete: the ratio computes (0.5) but with no limit slot the check is RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE and limit_value is none.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test unit_mismatch_between_ratio_and_limit_blocks: a limit slot declared with a non-ratio unit/dimension yields RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with a RULE_EVALUATOR_ERROR diagnostic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test compatible_rule_check_units_normalize_to_declared_units: MPa and kPa inputs normalize to the declared Pa unit before evaluation, yielding USER_RULE_CHECKED with normalized bound-input values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test incompatible_rule_check_units_block_before_evaluation: a length unit (mm) against a declared Pa stress unit yields RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with a UnitMismatch finding and the input left unsupplied, no formula evaluation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test status_outside_declared_result_statuses_is_downgraded: a computed PASS not in the declared result_statuses is downgraded to RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with a STATUS_NOT_DECLARED finding.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test aggregate_is_worst_of_across_checks: a pass on one check and a fail on a stricter check yields an aggregate of USER_RULE_FAILED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test private_library_value_is_unsupplied_not_silently_passed: a private_library_value input with no library binding is unsupplied with a note, yielding RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test private_library_value_resolves_from_library_binding_and_passes: a private-library limit resolved via LibraryValueBinding yields USER_RULE_CHECKED with a provenance note containing 'private library', the library id, and 'never embedded'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test private_library_value_with_failing_library_value_reports_failure: ratio 50/40 = 1.25 > 1.0 yields USER_RULE_FAILED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test emits_only_the_automatic_status_vocabulary: the serialized result must not contain HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT, Certified, Sealed, Approved, or code_compliant, and must contain USER_RULE_CHECKED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Integration test acceptability_relation_run exercises the additive optional acceptability_relation member on a CheckDefinition (TP-C4-ACCEPTREL-001) over the invented example rule pack; the member is backward compatible (absent uses less_than_or_equal).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test greater_than_or_equal_relation_flips_the_acceptance: under >=, ratio 0.5 fails and ratio 1.5 passes — inverting the default <= cases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test less_than_relation_is_strict_at_the_boundary: ratio exactly 1.0 passes under <= but fails under strict <, witnessing the relation drives the result.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test explicit_less_than_or_equal_matches_the_absent_default: the explicit less_than_or_equal token reproduces the historical hard-coded behaviour (ratio 1.0 <= 1.0 passes).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test unrecognized_relation_blocks_rather_than_defaulting: an explicit unsupported token (e.g. 'between') blocks at RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with relation 'none' and a RULE_EVALUATOR_ERROR finding.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Integration test invented_demo_run is an end-to-end rule-check run over the repository's invented example rule pack (examples/rule_packs/invented_demo.yaml, DEL-06-05) using the frozen-grammar evaluator and <= acceptability.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test example_pack_passing_run_is_user_rule_checked: solver 50 and limit 100 yield rule_pack_id invented_demo_rule_pack, grammar_version 1.0.0, USER_RULE_CHECKED, and a dimensionless ratio computed value of 0.5.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test example_pack_failing_run_is_user_rule_failed: solver 150 yields USER_RULE_FAILED with a computed ratio of 1.5.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Test example_pack_missing_solver_input_is_rule_inputs_incomplete: dropping the solver binding yields RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE with no computed value and relation 'none'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Crate open_pipe_stress_rule_pack_document is the rule-pack document seam: production codec between the rule-pack JSON document encoding and the frozen DEC-022 expression AST, JCS checksum computation, and document-level lifecycle validation; no text parsing, no protected content, no compliance claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: rule_pack_document depends on the expression_evaluator, rule_pack_lifecycle, and canonical_json crates plus serde and serde_json.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Crate rule_pack_document (Phase C2 backend, DEC-022 basis) is the production bridge between rule-pack JSON documents (schemas/rule_pack.schema.yaml) and the frozen expression grammar in the expression evaluator.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The codec maps between the node-tagged JSON expression encoding (pinned by fixtures/rule_expressions/conformance_corpus/) and the evaluator's typed AST.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The crate computes the RFC 8785 (JCS) checksum over a pack document with the checksums member excluded, grammar-version-bound per DEC-022 through the rule_pack_lifecycle crate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The crate provides document-level validation surfacing lifecycle, grammar, expression, and checksum findings for the desktop editor.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The crate does not parse expression text (a writable text syntax awaits the D-02b human ruling), does not store private payloads, does not choose storage paths, and emits no professional/certification/sealing/authentication/code-compliance claims.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: CHECKSUM_PAYLOAD_EXCLUDES is the document member excluded from the canonical checksum payload ('checksums'); the checksum cannot cover itself, and the exclusion is recorded in checksum evidence as payload_excludes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: CHECKSUM_BASIS is the stable label for how rule-pack document checksums are computed: 'rfc8785_jcs_sha256_excluding_checksums'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: DIMENSION_TOKENS is the canonical mapping between snake_case document dimension tokens and the evaluator Dimension enum (dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, stress, pressure, moment, etc., plus TBD).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function decode_dimension decodes a snake_case dimension token from the document vocabulary into a Dimension, or None when unknown.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function encode_dimension encodes an evaluator Dimension as its document token (every Dimension variant has a token).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct DecodeError is a decode failure with a JSON-path-style breadcrumb (path, message) for editor diagnostics.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Helper object() requires a JSON value to be an object, returning a DecodeError otherwise.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Helper member() fetches a required map member, returning a DecodeError 'missing required member' otherwise.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Helper string_member()/number_member() fetch a required member as a string or finite number, returning a DecodeError on type mismatch.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Helper optional_bool() reads an optional boolean member with a default.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function decode_quantity decodes a quantity object (value, dimension, unit_ref, optional unit_required and dimension_check_required defaulting true); an unknown dimension token is a DecodeError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function decode_table decodes a UserTable (table_id, argument/result dimensions and unit_refs, and rows of argument/result numbers); unknown dimension tokens or a non-array rows member are DecodeErrors.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function decode_expression decodes a node-tagged JSON expression into the evaluator AST.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: decode_expression accepts the full corpus encoding including the evaluator refusal markers unsupported_form / unsafe_host_access, which always evaluate to blocking findings; pack-document validation and the schema additionally reject refusal markers as authorable content.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: decode_expression dispatches on the node tag: literal, variable_ref, unary, binary, compare, logical, select, aggregate, interpolate, lookup, unsupported_form, unsafe_host_access; an unknown node kind is a DecodeError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Unary nodes accept operators negate, abs, not; an unknown operator is a DecodeError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Binary nodes accept operators add, subtract, multiply, divide; an unknown operator is a DecodeError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Compare nodes accept operators less_than, less_than_or_equal, greater_than, greater_than_or_equal, equal, not_equal; an unknown operator is a DecodeError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Logical nodes accept operators and, or; an unknown operator is a DecodeError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Select nodes decode a condition and then/else branches.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Aggregate nodes accept functions min, max over an operands array; an unknown function or non-array operands is a DecodeError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Interpolate nodes decode a table plus an argument expression.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Lookup nodes accept modes exact, step over a table and an argument; an unknown mode is a DecodeError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function encode_expression encodes an evaluator AST back into the node-tagged JSON encoding, the inverse of decode_expression across every node kind.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function expression_contains_refusal_marker returns true when an expression tree contains an evaluator refusal marker (UnsupportedForm or UnsafeHostAccess); refusal markers are engine vocabulary, never authorable pack content.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct DocumentError is a document-level failure (subject, message) that prevents checksum computation or validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function canonical_payload_bytes returns the RFC 8785 canonical byte payload a rule-pack checksum covers: the document with the CHECKSUM_PAYLOAD_EXCLUDES members removed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Struct ComputedRulePackChecksum is serializable checksum evidence (algorithm, canonicalization, payload_scope, payload_ref, payload_excludes, basis, grammar_version, grammar_version_bound, value).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Function compute_rule_pack_checksum computes the grammar-version-bound JCS checksum of a rule-pack document; the canonicalization label is 'JCS' because the function produces canonical bytes itself via canonical_json (RFC 8785).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The Pipe Section Property Calculator (DEL-03-08) implements bounded pipe section and mass-property calculations from user-entered dimensions and densities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The section calculator is intentionally narrow: it accepts already-parsed values (not external catalog formats), provides no schedule/dimensional/material/component defaults, does not convert units until the project unit catalog is accepted, records blocking diagnostics for missing/non-positive/incompatible inputs, and marks calculated values as derived from user-entered data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: For circular pipe sections the calculator derives effective inside diameter after corrosion allowance, metal area, second moment of area, elastic section modulus, polar/torsional constant, contents volume per length, and metal/contents/insulation/total mass per length when matching density inputs are provided.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Inputs remain user-supplied; public fixtures and schemas must not use this module to smuggle protected dimensional tables, proprietary catalog values, code-specific allowables, SIFs, flexibility factors, or private project data into the repository.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: core/section_properties/calculator.py computes pipe section and mass properties from user-entered values; it provides no dimensional tables, material defaults, unit-conversion constants, or catalog lookups, requires explicit compatible unit metadata, and reports diagnostics when inputs are insufficient.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: calculator.py constants: LENGTH_DIMENSIONS={"length"}, DENSITY_DIMENSIONS={"density"}, DIAGNOSTIC_SOURCE="core/section_properties/calculator.py".
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PipeSectionResult frozen dataclass holds properties dict and diagnostics tuple; its accepted property is true when no diagnostic has blocking severity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: calculate_pipe_section_properties computes pipe section properties using explicit compatible units only, validating required and optional quantities and returning early with diagnostics if any are present.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: calculate_pipe_section_properties enforces a single shared length unit across outside_diameter, wall_thickness, corrosion_allowance, and insulation_thickness inputs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: calculate_pipe_section_properties enforces a single (optional) density unit across material, contents, and insulation densities.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: effective_wall = wall.magnitude - corrosion_value, and inside_diameter = od.magnitude - 2*effective_wall.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The calculator emits SECTION_CALCULATION_INPUT_INVALID when corrosion allowance leaves no positive effective wall, when inside diameter is negative, or when insulation thickness is negative.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Section geometry formulas: metal_area = pi/4*(OD^2 - ID^2); moment_of_inertia = pi/64*(OD^4 - ID^4); section_modulus = I/(OD/2); torsional_constant = pi/32*(OD^4 - ID^4); contents_volume_per_length = pi/4*ID^2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The properties dict carries inside_diameter, metal_area, cross_section_area, moment_of_inertia (unit length^4), section_modulus (length^3), torsional_constant (length^4), and contents_volume_per_length (length^2) as Quantity values with dimension labels.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Mass-per-length parts are computed only when a density unit is present: metal_mass = metal_area*material_density; contents_mass = contents_volume_per_length*contents_density; insulation_mass = insulation_area*insulation_density.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Insulation outside diameter = OD + 2*insulation_thickness and insulation_area = pi/4*(insulation_OD^2 - OD^2).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: When mass parts exist, each is given unit density_unit*length^2 with dimension mass_per_length and a total mass_per_length is added as their sum.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: StorageGuardResult holds target_context, decisions, diagnostics, and safe_manifest; blocked is true if any decision is blocked.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: StorageGuardResult.summary reports record_count, blocked, blocking/warning counts, metadata_only, cloud-or-network and direct-SQL block counts, and asserts secret_material_stored/payloads_stored/concrete_paths_emitted/professional_claims_made all False.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: storage_record(...) builds a metadata-only StorageRecord, defaulting locality/privacy/descriptor by kind and deriving cloud/network, direct-SQL, and concrete-path flags from locality.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: storage_record defaults: redistribution_status private_only, review_status pending, source_state private_user_supplied, source_note/checksum_status TBD, contains_payload/secret/concrete/cloud/sql False.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: classify_storage_record classifies one record using only explicit metadata: it normalizes, gathers classification diagnostics, derives reason and action (block_storage if blocking else include_metadata_only), and returns a StorageDecision with a stable decision id.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: guard_storage_records returns context-specific guard decisions and a safe metadata manifest, treating explicit_local_private_intent as explicit_user_intent and raising ValueError for a target_context not in STORAGE_CONTEXTS.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _normalize_storage_record coerces a StorageRecord or mapping into a StorageRecord (raising TypeError otherwise), inferring kind, detecting payload/secret/concrete-path/cloud-network/direct-SQL signals from keys, and withholding source detail when any unsafe detail is present.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Normalization detects unsafe detail via PAYLOAD_KEYS, SECRET_MATERIAL_KEYS, concrete-path heuristics, BLOCKED_REMOTE_CONTEXTS / CLOUD_NETWORK_KEYS, and DIRECT_SQL_CONTEXTS / DIRECT_SQL_KEYS; secret material also requires a payload key when inferred from kind/name.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classification_diagnostics emits STORAGE_RECORD_KIND_UNKNOWN (WARNING) for an unresolved record kind.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classification_diagnostics emits BLOCKING CLOUD_OR_NETWORK_STORAGE_BLOCKED, DIRECT_SQL_ACCESS_BLOCKED, SECRET_MATERIAL_METADATA_ONLY_REQUIRED, and STORAGE_PAYLOAD_METADATA_ONLY_REQUIRED for the corresponding detected detail.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classification_diagnostics emits CONCRETE_PATH_REDUCED_TO_SAFE_METADATA (WARNING) when concrete path detail was detected and withheld.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classification_diagnostics emits BLOCKING PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_PRIVATE_STORAGE_BLOCKED when private storage metadata targets PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_CONTENT.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classification_diagnostics emits WARNINGs REDISTRIBUTION_STATUS_UNRESOLVED, PRIVACY_CLASSIFICATION_UNRESOLVED, and SOURCE_STATE_UNRESOLVED for unknown statuses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classification_diagnostics emits BLOCKING REVIEW_DISPOSITION_BLOCKED for quarantined/rejected review and PROTECTED_SOURCE_SUSPECTED for protected-suspected redistribution or review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _guard_record gathers classification diagnostics, computes (action, reason) via _guard_action, appends a diagnostic for the reason if absent, and returns a StorageDecision with a stable LFS-GRD id and safe manifest metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _guard_action blocks remote (CLOUD_OR_NETWORK_CONTEXT_BLOCKED) and direct-SQL (DIRECT_SQL_CONTEXT_BLOCKED) target contexts, and blocks records carrying cloud/network, direct-SQL, secret, payload, blocking-review, or protected-suspected detail.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: For PUBLIC_SHARED_CONTEXTS, _guard_action blocks concrete paths, private records, unknown privacy, and unknown redistribution, else allows SAFE_PUBLIC_METADATA.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: For LOCAL_PRIVATE_CONTEXTS, _guard_action requires explicit user intent for private records (LOCAL_PRIVATE_INTENT_REQUIRED), reduces concrete paths to safe metadata, allows private local metadata, and otherwise allows safe public metadata; unsupported contexts return UNSUPPORTED_STORAGE_CONTEXT.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _safe_manifest_metadata withholds concrete-path, cloud/network, direct-SQL, secret, and payload detail in the manifest, and for private records in public/shared contexts also withholds checksum and private detail.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classification_reason returns the first blocking diagnostic code if blocking, else PRIVATE_METADATA_LOCAL_FIRST for private records, SAFE_PUBLIC_METADATA for public privacy classes, else REVIEW_REQUIRED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _default_posture returns blocked_until_metadata_only_local_first if blocking, local_private_metadata_requires_explicit_intent for private records, public_metadata_allowed for public privacy classes, else review_required.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _diagnostic constructs a StorageDiagnostic from code, severity, path, message, and remediation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _message_for_reason and _remediation_for_reason map each reason code to its human-readable message and remediation text.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _severity_for_action returns BLOCKING for block_storage and WARNING otherwise; _has_blocking is true if any diagnostic is BLOCKING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _storage_kind normalizes a record kind via an alias map (e.g. rule/rule_pack->private_rule_pack, secret/credential->secret_reference, public->public_metadata).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _privacy_for_kind maps each storage kind to its default privacy classification (e.g. private_rule_pack->private_rule_pack_data, secret_reference->secret_like_data, public kinds->public_metadata).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _storage_locality_for_kind maps each kind to its default symbolic storage root (e.g. private_rule_pack->USER_PRIVATE_RULE_PACK_ROOT, secret_reference->USER_SECRET_REFERENCE, public_metadata->PUBLIC_REPOSITORY_CONTENT).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _infer_record_kind infers a kind from record id/label/name text using secret-name markers and keyword matches (rule, material, component, report, diagnostic, cache, project/model), else returns the fallback.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _is_private returns true when the record kind, privacy classification, redistribution status, or storage locality indicates private/user storage.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _looks_secret_like returns true when the kind is secret_reference or the record's identifying text contains a secret name marker.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _looks_concrete_path returns false for unknown/symbolic/USER_/PUBLIC_/LOCAL_CACHE_ROOT values and true when the text contains '/', '\\', ':', or 'FAKE_CONCRETE'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _unresolved_items returns the names of supplied values that fall in UNKNOWN_STATUSES.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _stable_id builds a deterministic id by sha256-hashing canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators) of the payload and taking the first 16 hex chars with a prefix.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _string returns a default for None/empty, the value for non-empty strings, else str(value); _optional_string returns None for None else str; _tuple_strings normalizes a value into a tuple of strings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: core/security/redaction provides local redaction and export-control helpers for report/export payloads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Module core/security/redaction/controls.py provides bounded local redaction controls for report/export representations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Redaction functions operate on already-parsed dictionaries/lists and return a redacted copy without mutating the source payload.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Redaction functions do not read files, move quarantine material, transmit data, or infer sensitivity from value text.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PUBLIC_CONTEXTS comprises public_report, public_example, shared_model, and downstream_tool; EXPORT_CONTEXTS adds local_private.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: SAFE_PRIVACY_CLASSES are public, public_metadata, and invented_public_example.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PRIVATE_PRIVACY_CLASSES include private_project_data, private_material_data, private_component_data, private_rule_pack_data, owner_standard_data, company_design_basis_data, path_data, and secret_like_data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PAYLOAD_DETAIL_KEYS, SECRET_MATERIAL_KEYS, CONCRETE_PATH_DETAIL_KEYS, CLOUD_NETWORK_DETAIL_KEYS, and DIRECT_SQL_DETAIL_KEYS define the unsafe detail keys (UNSAFE_DETAIL_KEYS) stripped during redaction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RedactionDecision is a frozen dataclass capturing decision_id, path, field_class, privacy_classification, redistribution_status, review_status, export_context, action, reason_code, and source_metadata_present.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RedactionFinding is a frozen dataclass with finding_id, code, class_, severity, path, action, message, and remediation; as_schema_dict renames class_ to class.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RedactionResult holds payload, decisions, and findings; blocked is true when any decision action is block_export.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: redact_export_payload returns a redacted export/report representation plus findings, basing sensitivity decisions only on explicit metadata fields.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A value-bearing object without metadata is treated as unresolved and is redacted or blocked according to the export context.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: redact_export_payload raises ValueError when export_context is not in EXPORT_CONTEXTS.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: classify_export_item classifies a single metadata-bearing export item, raising ValueError on unsupported export_context.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _is_value_bearing treats an item as value-bearing when it has a value or text key, explicit metadata, or unsafe item detail.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _action_for blocks export on professional_claim, cloud/network reference, direct SQL access, storage bypass, secret material, or payload presence.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _action_for redacts the value when a concrete path is present (reason CONCRETE_PATH_REDACTED).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _action_for blocks export for protected_suspected privacy/redistribution and for quarantined or rejected review status (PROTECTED_CONTENT_BLOCKED).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Items with safe privacy class and public redistribution status are included, tagged SAFE_INVENTED_PUBLIC_EXAMPLE or SAFE_PUBLIC_METADATA.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Private data in a local_private context is allowed only with a warning when explicit_local_private_intent is set; otherwise it is blocked (LOCAL_PRIVATE_INTENT_REQUIRED) or redacted for non-local contexts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _unknown_action returns warning_only for local_private export context and redact_value otherwise.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _finding_for maps reason codes to a finding class and severity (BLOCKING for block_export, else WARNING), returning None for include actions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _apply_action redacts value/text fields to REDACTED_VALUE and sets privacy_classification to redacted for redact_value and block_export actions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _without_unsafe_detail returns a copy of the item with UNSAFE_DETAIL_KEYS removed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Package core/security/secret_private_library provides local-first secret and private-library reference controls.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The secret_private_library package __all__ re-exports GuardDecision, GuardResult, ReferenceRecord, classify_reference, guard_reference_release, and related symbols from controls.
Module secret_private_library/controls.py provides deterministic local-first controls for secret/private-library references, handling metadata records only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The control never reads referenced files, stores credential values or private-library payloads, moves quarantine material, contacts a service, or makes rights/professional determinations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RELEASE_CONTEXTS combine PUBLIC_RELEASE_CONTEXTS (public_report, public_example, public_fixture, shared_model, downstream_tool) and LOCAL_RELEASE_CONTEXTS (local_private, private_registry, private_diagnostic).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: REFERENCE_KINDS comprise PRIVATE_LIBRARY_KINDS, PRIVATE_PATH_KINDS (private_path, private_path_reference), and SECRET_KINDS (secret_field, secret_field_reference, credential_placeholder).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PAYLOAD_KEYS, SECRET_MATERIAL_KEYS, CONCRETE_PATH_DETAIL_KEYS, CLOUD_NETWORK_DETAIL_KEYS, DIRECT_SQL_DETAIL_KEYS, STORAGE_BYPASS_KEYS, and EXTERNAL_SECRET_MANAGER_KEYS define unsafe-detail marker sets.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: SYMBOLIC_REFERENCE_LOCALITIES enumerate the allowed symbolic storage-locality tokens such as USER_PRIVATE_LIBRARY_ROOT, USER_SECRET_REFERENCE, and LOCAL_CACHE_ROOT.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: GuardDiagnostic is a frozen dataclass with code, severity, path, message, and remediation fields.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ReferenceRecord is a frozen dataclass holding metadata-only reference fields including reference_id, record_kind, storage_locality, privacy_classification, redistribution_status, checksum, and unsafe-detail flags, defaulting value_descriptor to metadata_reference_only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ReferenceRecord.metadata_dict returns a metadata-only view and, when concrete_path_present, withholds concrete-path detail by substituting concrete_path_detail_withheld.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: ReferenceClassification is a frozen dataclass carrying classification_id, default_posture, diagnostics, and metadata; blocked is true when any diagnostic is BLOCKING.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: GuardDecision is a frozen dataclass with decision_id, reference_id, record_kind, release_context, action, reason_code, and metadata_only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: GuardResult holds release_context, decisions, diagnostics, and safe_manifest; blocked is true when any decision action is block_release.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: GuardResult.summary reports counts and asserts concrete_paths_emitted, cloud_transmission_attempted, external_secret_manager_used, and professional_claims_made are all False.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: private_library_reference builds a metadata-only private-library reference record, deriving privacy class from the library kind and recording unresolved TBD items.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: private_path_reference builds a symbolic private-path reference record, withholding concrete-path detail when the path class looks concrete.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: secret_field_reference builds a secret-like field record that carries no usable value, using a placeholder_key_id descriptor.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: credential_placeholder builds an opaque credential placeholder record with secret_material_present set to False.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: classify_reference classifies one reference using only explicit metadata, assigning a stable classification id and a default posture.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: classify_references classifies references in input order with deterministic per-record IDs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: guard_reference_release returns guard decisions and a metadata-only manifest for references, raising ValueError on unsupported release_context.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _normalize_reference converts a mapping into a ReferenceRecord, detecting payload, secret, concrete-path, cloud/network, external-secret-manager, direct-SQL, and storage-bypass markers, and withholding unsafe detail when present.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _classification_diagnostics emits a WARNING when the reference kind is unknown.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Secret-like material in a reference record produces the BLOCKING diagnostic SECRET_MATERIAL_REFERENCE_ONLY_REQUIRED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Cloud or network reference metadata produces the BLOCKING diagnostic CLOUD_OR_NETWORK_REFERENCE_BLOCKED, keeping handling local-only unless a later approved workflow authorizes an exception.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: External secret-manager metadata produces the BLOCKING diagnostic EXTERNAL_SECRET_MANAGER_BLOCKED until credential-store integration is separately approved.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Direct SQL or raw SQLite interface metadata produces the BLOCKING diagnostic DIRECT_SQL_ACCESS_BLOCKED, requiring application-service persistence boundaries.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Storage-bypass metadata produces the BLOCKING diagnostic STORAGE_BYPASS_BLOCKED, requiring routing through local-first storage, redaction, provenance, and application-service controls.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Concrete path-like detail is withheld and produces the WARNING diagnostic CONCRETE_PATH_REDUCED_TO_SAFE_METADATA, favoring symbolic path classes or opaque local references.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Payload data present in a private-library, private-path, or other reference record produces a BLOCKING payload-reference-only-required diagnostic requiring metadata-only storage.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Unresolved redistribution status, privacy classification, or source/provenance state each produce a WARNING diagnostic requiring resolution before release.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: A quarantined or rejected review status produces the BLOCKING diagnostic REVIEW_DISPOSITION_BLOCKED.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Reference metadata indicating protected_suspected status produces the BLOCKING diagnostic PROTECTED_SOURCE_SUSPECTED, routing for human review and keeping it out of public artifacts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _guard_action blocks release in priority order for secret material, cloud/network, external secret manager, direct SQL, storage bypass, payload presence, blocking review status, and protected-suspected status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: In public release contexts, private data with unknown redistribution is blocked (UNKNOWN_REDIS_PRIVATE_DATA_BLOCKED) and unknown privacy is blocked (UNKNOWN_PRIVACY_PUBLIC_BLOCKED).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Private references are blocked from public_fixture contexts (PRIVATE_REFERENCE_PUBLIC_FIXTURE_BLOCKED) and otherwise included metadata-only in public contexts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: In local contexts, private references require explicit_local_private_intent (else LOCAL_PRIVATE_INTENT_REQUIRED) and are then included metadata-only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _default_posture returns blocked_until_reference_only_metadata when any diagnostic is BLOCKING, local_private_metadata_only for private records, public_metadata_allowed for public classes, else review_required.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _is_private_library, _is_private_path, and _is_secret classify a record by its record_kind against the corresponding kind sets.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _is_private treats a record as private when its kind, privacy class, redistribution status, or storage locality is private.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _looks_concrete_path flags strings that start with /, ~/, or \\, contain :/ or :\, start with file:// or sqlite://, or end with .sqlite/.sqlite3/.db.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: _stable_id derives a deterministic ID by sha256-hashing canonical JSON of the payload and taking the first 16 hex digits with a prefix.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Package core/security/telemetry_policy provides metadata-only telemetry policy guard helpers.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

Module telemetry_policy/controls.py provides metadata-only telemetry guard controls resolving telemetry configuration and event attempts.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The telemetry guard does not construct telemetry payloads, open network transports, select vendors, start queues, or persist telemetry data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: APPROVED_OPERATIONAL_FIELD_CLASSES are operational_metadata, public_metadata, and low_sensitivity_metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: CONFIG_KEYS enumerate the supported telemetry config keys including enabled, explicit_opt_in, consent_surface, approved_consent_surfaces, allowlist_approved, and event_allowlist.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RUNTIME_SURFACE_KEYS (endpoint, vendor, transport, queue, persistence, upload, etc.) are forbidden runtime transport/persistence surfaces in telemetry config.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: PAYLOAD_SHAPED_KEYS (content, payload, raw, text, value, values, etc.) mark payload-shaped data not allowed before guard approval.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: FORBIDDEN_FIELD_CLASS_TOKENS list classes (private/protected/secret/path/report/professional/company_design_basis/etc.) that telemetry may never carry.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: FORBIDDEN_FIELD_MARKERS and FORBIDDEN_EVENT_MARKERS list substrings (secret, credential, path, model, report, rule, private, protected, etc.) that bar a field name or event name from telemetry.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: TelemetryConfig is a frozen dataclass holding enabled, requested_enabled, explicit_opt_in, consent_surface, approved_consent_surfaces, allowlist_approved, event_allowlist, diagnostics, and reason_code.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: TelemetryConfig.as_schema_dict reports all runtime surfaces (network_transport, endpoint, vendor, upload_queue, persistence, external_service_client) as not initialized.

UnitStatement: The sparse ordering is reverse Cuthill-McKee, chosen as the classic bandwidth/profile-reducing ordering for banded/branched frame topologies and as a pure breadth-first traversal admitting a fully deterministic formulation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RCM determinism: the result is a pure function of the undirected graph; adjacency lists are symmetrized, sorted, and deduplicated so caller list order cannot change the result.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RCM determinism: connected components are processed in order of their lowest original node index.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RCM determinism: each component starts from a pseudo-peripheral node found by level-structure iteration, with every tie broken by ascending (degree, original index).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: RCM determinism: breadth-first neighbor visits are ordered by ascending (degree, original index), and the concatenated order is reversed once at the end; no randomization, threading, or platform-dependent iteration order is used.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: The factorization and solve are single-threaded straight-line f64 arithmetic with a fixed operation order, no reassociation/blocking/SIMD/parallel reduction, preserving byte-reproducibility like the dense path; repeat-run bitwise identity is asserted in tests.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_CORE -> CAT-026.

UnitStatement: Physical dimensions are encoded as (length, force) integer-exponent tuples: dimensionless (0,0), length (1,0), force (0,1), moment (1,1), stress (-2,1), area (2,0), section_modulus (3,0), second_moment_area (4,0).

UnitStatement: Supported OpenMath arith1 operators are: plus, minus, times, divide, power.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: WitnessError is raised when a formal witness is invalid or generated artifacts are stale.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: QuantityValue is a frozen dataclass holding a Decimal value, unit string, dimension tuple, and dimension name.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: FormulaEvaluation is a frozen dataclass holding formula_id, display, expression, and a QuantityValue.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: Comparison is a frozen dataclass holding formula_id, result_id, witness_value, ops_value, abs_delta, tolerance, and a passed flag.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: WitnessEvaluation is a frozen dataclass holding witness_id, witness_sha256, formula_evaluations, and comparisons.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: load_json reads and parses a UTF-8 JSON file from a path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: canonical_sha256 computes the SHA-256 hex digest over the witness serialized as canonical JSON with sorted keys and compact separators.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: repo_path resolves a path against ROOT when it is not absolute.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: decimal_text formats a Decimal as fixed-point text, returning '0' for zero.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: dimension_name maps a dimension vector to its name, falling back to 'derived<vector>' for unknown vectors.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: validate_schema validates the witness against the Draft 2020-12 JSON schema and raises WitnessError on the first error.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: quantity_from_binding constructs a QuantityValue from a binding's quantity, reading decimal, unit, and dimension.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: arith_result computes the QuantityValue result of an arith1 operator over argument QuantityValues, raising WitnessError for unsupported operators.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: For arith1.plus and arith1.minus, all argument dimensions must match the first argument's dimension or a dimension mismatch error is raised.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: arith1.minus requires exactly two arguments.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: arith1.times multiplies argument decimals and adds their dimension exponents component-wise.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: arith1.divide requires exactly two arguments and subtracts the divisor's dimension exponents from the dividend's.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: arith1.power requires exactly two arguments.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: The arith1.power exponent must be dimensionless and an integer, otherwise WitnessError is raised.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: arith1.power multiplies the base dimension exponents by the integer exponent.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: evaluate_openmath recursively evaluates an OpenMath node into a QuantityValue given bound values, formulas, and an evaluation stack.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: An OMV node resolves to a bound value, else recurses into a formula of the same name; an unknown variable raises WitnessError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: A formula graph cycle is detected when an OMV name already appears on the evaluation stack, raising WitnessError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: OMI and OMF nodes evaluate to dimensionless QuantityValues with unit '1'.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: An OMS node is supported only for nums1.pi, which must be present in bound values; other symbols raise WitnessError.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: An OMA node's operator must be an OMS in the arith1 content dictionary; otherwise the operator is unsupported.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: An OMA node evaluates its arguments recursively and applies arith_result with the operator name.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: evaluate_formula evaluates a formula by id, memoizing into values and detecting cycles via the stack.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: A formula's evaluated dimension must match its expected_dimension or WitnessError is raised.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: evaluate_formula stores the result with the formula's expected_unit and expected_dimension.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-004: CODE_VALIDATION -> CAT-030.

UnitStatement: display_map builds an id-to-display lookup over the witness constants, inputs, and formulas sections.

UnitStatement: expression_for renders an OpenMath node into a human-readable infix expression string using the display map.
