UnitStatement: Document title: CONTRACT — OpenPipeStress Invariant Catalog.
This document defines binding invariants for agentic development of OpenPipeStress.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Invariants are intended to become enforceable through schemas, tests, linters, review gates, and human governance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Invariant index.
OPS-K-HIER-1: Packages are flat work domains; deliverables are the smallest production units. Enforced via SOFTWARE_DECOMP coverage audit and human review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-ID-1: Package, deliverable, scope, objective, decision, and issue IDs are stable and not reused. Enforced via decomposition registers and review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-IP-1: The public repository must not contain protected standards text, tables, figures, examples, copied code formulas, material allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, protected dimensional tables, or proprietary commercial data. Enforced via contributor review, report linter, and legal review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-IP-2: Every public data contribution must include source, provenance, license/redistribution status, contributor certification, and review disposition. Enforced via data import validator and contribution checklist.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-IP-3: Suspected protected content must be quarantined and escalated; agents must not paraphrase protected tables into public data. Enforced via stop rule and human/legal review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-DATA-1: Code-specific values are user-supplied or lawfully imported private data, not bundled public defaults. Enforced via rule-pack completeness checker and library governance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-DATA-2: Missing solve-required or rule-check-required values are explicit findings, never silent defaults. Enforced via GUI warnings and solver/rule engine validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-DATA-3: Materials, components, SIFs, flexibility factors, allowables, and rule-pack values carry provenance fields. Enforced via schema validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AUTH-1: Software and agents must not claim to certify, seal, approve, authenticate, or declare engineering code compliance for reliance. Enforced via report templates, product-claims policy, and review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AUTH-2: Human acceptance records, if used, bind to specific model/rule/report hashes and do not survive content changes without re-review. Enforced via audit manifest and hash checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-MECH-1: The primary global analysis model is a 3D centerline/frame model; shell/solid FEA is a local-analysis handoff path. Enforced via architecture review and docs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-MECH-2: The solver computes mechanics; rule packs evaluate user-defined acceptability; professional compliance remains human judgment. Enforced via analysis status model and reports.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-UNIT-1: All calculations, formulas, imported values, and exports must be unit-aware and dimensionally checked. Enforced via unit tests, schema validation, and rule evaluator.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-SOLVER-1: Solver changes require deterministic verification tests before release. Enforced via CI and V&V gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-SOLVER-2: Nonlinear support behavior must report convergence, active-set state, and unresolved non-convergence. Enforced via solver tests and result schema.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-RULE-1: Public rule-pack examples must use invented non-code values and clear non-engineering notices. Enforced via contribution review and report linter.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-RULE-2: The expression evaluator is sandboxed; rule packs cannot execute arbitrary code. Enforced via security tests and architecture review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-RULE-3: Rule packs are versioned, checksummed, source-noted, and marked public/private. Enforced via rule-pack schema validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-REPORT-1: Reports must disclose model version, solver version, rule-pack checksum, source/provenance notes, warnings, assumptions, and limitations. Enforced via report generator tests.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-REPORT-2: Public report templates and examples must not reproduce protected standards content. Enforced via report protected-content linter and human review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-PRIV-1: Private project, material, component, and rule-pack data must not be transmitted or committed publicly by default. Enforced via storage policy, telemetry config, and CI checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-PRIV-2: Telemetry is off by default and cannot include private engineering/code data. Enforced via security review and telemetry tests.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-GOV-1: The human project authority selected PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0.0 as the project license on 2026-06-03; governance and release records must state the selected license without treating it as legal advice, professional approval, certification, sealing, authentication, or a code-compliance claim. Enforced via maintainer policy and release review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-GOV-2: Maintainer authority, release authority, and public-governance decisions must be recorded in public governance artifacts before they are treated as project policy. Enforced via maintainer policy and decision records.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-GOV-3: Public releases must disclose scope, validation status, known limitations, data-boundary constraints, and professional-responsibility limitations. Enforced via release checklist and human review gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-GOV-4: Maintainers must apply IP, provenance, privacy, and protected-content review before accepting public repository contributions. Enforced via contribution review and protected-content gate.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AGENT-1: Agents must not invent engineering values, scope, source citations, or legal conclusions; unknowns become TBD. Enforced via agent instructions and review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AGENT-2: Agents must surface conflicts and gaps rather than silently resolving them. Enforced via review and conflict/open issue registers.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AGENT-3: Type 2 execution requires sealed context and explicit deliverable scope. Enforced via agentic workflow and orchestration.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: OPS-K-AGENT-4: Agent outputs are drafts/proposals until accepted by a human gate. Enforced via review and lifecycle state.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Enforcement map.
Enforcement map: Decomposition review checks invariants OPS-K-HIER-1, OPS-K-ID-1, and OPS-K-AGENT-3.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Schema validation checks invariants OPS-K-DATA-2, OPS-K-DATA-3, OPS-K-UNIT-1, and OPS-K-RULE-3.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: CI/test suite checks invariants OPS-K-UNIT-1, OPS-K-SOLVER-1, OPS-K-SOLVER-2, OPS-K-RULE-2, and OPS-K-REPORT-2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Contributor review checks invariants OPS-K-IP-1, OPS-K-IP-2, OPS-K-IP-3, and OPS-K-RULE-1.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Report generation checks invariants OPS-K-AUTH-1, OPS-K-MECH-2, OPS-K-REPORT-1, and OPS-K-REPORT-2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Human review gate checks invariants OPS-K-AUTH-1, OPS-K-AUTH-2, and OPS-K-AGENT-4.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Security/privacy review checks invariants OPS-K-PRIV-1, OPS-K-PRIV-2, and OPS-K-RULE-2.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Enforcement map: Maintainer/release governance checks invariants OPS-K-GOV-1, OPS-K-GOV-2, OPS-K-GOV-3, OPS-K-GOV-4, OPS-K-IP-1, OPS-K-IP-2, OPS-K-IP-3, and OPS-K-AUTH-1.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-CONTRACT -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Example provenance source categories: user licensed code, owner specification, manufacturer catalog, vendor calculation, test report, engineering calculation, public-domain source, invented example value, and unknown/unverified.

UnitStatement: The software must make it easier for an engineer to understand and defend a calculation and must not hide input assumptions, substitutions, or code-relevant decisions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: All input, internal calculation, output, rule evaluation, and import/export operations must be unit-aware; unit conversions must be deterministic and reportable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Piping Stress Engineer persona needs to create flexibility models, apply project data, solve load cases, review stresses and reactions, and issue calculation reports.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Piping Stress Engineer key needs: fast model creation, familiar piping components, load-case and support workflows, reliable stress/reaction reports, manual entry of licensed code data, and an audit trail for all project inputs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Owner-Operator Reviewer persona needs to review whether an EPC or vendor model is complete, traceable, and consistent with owner requirements.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Owner-Operator Reviewer key needs: clear assumptions, rule-pack identification, data provenance, missing-data warnings, and report reproducibility.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Engineering Company Administrator persona needs to maintain private company rule packs, component libraries, default project templates, and approved calculation-report formats.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Engineering Company Administrator key needs: private libraries, access control, versioned templates, rule-pack checksums, and no accidental redistribution of protected code data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Open-Source Contributor persona needs to contribute solver improvements, GUI features, validation cases, documentation, and permissively licensed data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Open-Source Contributor key needs: clear architecture, contribution policy, IP review gates, automated tests, and public validation cases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Educator or Researcher persona needs transparent examples for teaching piping flexibility and stress analysis without relying on proprietary commercial software.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Educator or Researcher key needs: non-code example models, mechanics-based validation problems, clear theory documentation, and inspectable solver outputs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Create/Analyze: create a new project, select a unit system, define design basis metadata, and create or import a private rule pack.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Create/Analyze: define materials with temperature-dependent properties, pipe sections, and component properties.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Create/Analyze: build the 3D piping centerline in the GUI and insert bends, branches, valves, flanges, reducers, expansion joints, and supports.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Create/Analyze: assign pressures, temperatures, weights, contents, insulation, and imposed displacements, then define primitive load cases and combination cases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Create/Analyze: solve the model and review displacements, rotations, forces, moments, support reactions, and stresses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Create/Analyze: run private rule-pack checks, resolve warnings and missing data, and generate an auditable calculation report.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Build Rule Pack: open the rule-pack editor and select a blank schema or company template.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Build Rule Pack: define stress categories, load combinations, required variables, allowables, and expressions using licensed/proprietary sources, then mark the rule pack private.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Build Rule Pack: software validates unit consistency and required input mappings, generates a checksum and version identifier, and the rule pack becomes available for private project use only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Import Component Data: import a private component library file; software checks schema, units, required fields, and provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Import Component Data: software flags records with missing source or required dimensions; user assigns components to model elements.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Import Component Data: report records component library name, version, source notes, and checksum.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Educational example: open a public example model with invented material and allowable values and solve a simple U-loop or frame benchmark.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User journey - Educational example: compare displacement and force results with hand-calculation references; no code-compliance claim is made.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The first MVP must establish the analysis foundation and data-separation model.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MVP must include 3D nodes with six degrees of freedom, straight pipe/beam elements, rigid elements, and linear anchors and restraints.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MVP must include weight loads, thermal loads, internal pressure metadata with basic pressure-derived stress recovery, and imposed displacements.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MVP must include a linear static solver, element force and moment recovery, and fundamental stress recovery.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MVP must include YAML/JSON project files, CSV/tabular results, and a basic GUI modeler.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MVP must include a rule-pack schema with placeholder/example non-code rules and blocking warnings for missing required rule-pack inputs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MVP must include an initial validation suite and calculation report export.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Post-MVP: add bend elements with user-entered SIFs/flexibility factors and branch connection objects with user-entered local modifiers.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Post-MVP: add reducers, flanges, valves, expansion joints, and spring hangers.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Post-MVP: add nonlinear supports including gaps, one-way supports, lift-off, friction, and sliding restraints.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Post-MVP: add load-case algebra and range cases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Post-MVP: add dynamic modules - modal, response spectrum, harmonic, and time-history support.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Post-MVP: add local FEA export workflows, an open validation manual, private library management, and CAD/BIM import/export.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-001 (Must): Create, open, save, and version projects; project file round-trips without loss of model, units, loads, rule-pack references, or provenance metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-002 (Must): Support explicit unit systems and conversions; all numerical fields have units, incompatible units are rejected, and reports show units used.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-003 (Must): Provide 3D node and element modeling; user can create and edit nodes, straight pipe elements, and rigid elements in 3D.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-004 (Must): Support six degrees of freedom per structural node; solver supports translation and rotation in X/Y/Z at every active node.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-005 (Must): Provide pipe section property calculations; area, moment of inertia, section modulus, and mass properties calculated from user-entered OD/wall/density data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-006 (Must): Allow user-defined materials including density, elastic modulus, Poisson's ratio, thermal expansion data, and user-entered allowables where needed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-007 (Must): Support basic load cases - weight, temperature, pressure metadata, concentrated loads, and imposed displacements can be defined and solved.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-008 (Must): Solve linear static global flexibility problems; solver passes benchmark tests for beams, frames, thermal cases, and imposed displacements.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-009 (Must): Recover element forces and moments; local and global force/moment results available at element ends.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-010 (Must): Recover fundamental stresses - axial, bending, torsional, and pressure-derived stress quantities displayed independently of code checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-011 (Must): Provide rule-pack schema; users define private stress checks, variables, expressions, allowables, and load-combination mappings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-012 (Must): Block incomplete code checks; software refuses to report pass/fail when required rule-pack values are missing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-013 (Must): Provide graphical 3D modeler; user can create/edit pipe geometry, supports, components, and load assignments visually.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-014 (Must): Provide model tree and property editor; every model entity selectable and editable through structured property panels.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-015 (Must): Provide results visualization - deformed shape, support reactions, stress tables, and governing ratios viewable in the GUI.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-016 (Must): Generate calculation reports including input summary, assumptions, rule-pack checksum, warnings, results, and provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-017 (Should): Support bend objects accepting radius, angle, orientation, user-entered SIFs, and user-entered flexibility factors.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-018 (Should): Support branch connection objects accepting geometry and user-entered local modifiers for header/branch checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-019 (Should): Support valves/flanges/reducers represented as rigid or semi-rigid elements with user-entered dimensions, weights, and source notes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-020 (Should): Support expansion joints accepting user-entered stiffnesses, effective pressure area, movement limits, and manufacturer provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-021 (Should): Support nonlinear restraints; gaps, lift-off, one-way supports, and friction converge for validation cases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-022 (Should): Support private material/component libraries that are not redistributed with the open-source package.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-023 (Could): Support import/export; project and result data exchangeable using open formats.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-024 (Could): Support dynamic analysis modules; modal and response-spectrum modules pass validation benchmarks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FR-025 (Could): Support local FEA export; selected local geometry and loads exportable for external shell/solid analysis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver shall use a 3D line-element model of the piping centerline; each structural node shall support six degrees of freedom (Ux, Uy, Uz, Rx, Ry, Rz).
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Each element shall assemble a local stiffness contribution into the global stiffness matrix.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver shall support local-to-global coordinate transformations, element-end force recovery, and result extraction in both local and global coordinate systems.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The initial solver shall implement linear elastic, small-displacement, static 3D frame analysis; later versions may add geometric nonlinearity and advanced material behavior as optional modules.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Minimum solver capabilities: sparse global stiffness matrix assembly, boundary condition enforcement, imposed displacement handling, and thermal initial strain handling.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Minimum solver capabilities: distributed and concentrated load handling, rigid-link/rigid-element support, and deterministic solution results.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Minimum solver capabilities: singularity and ill-conditioning detection and unit-aware result storage.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The straight pipe element shall support axial stiffness, bending stiffness about two local transverse axes, and torsional stiffness.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The straight pipe element shall support user-entered or calculated section properties, distributed weight, thermal strain, and pressure metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The straight pipe element shall provide stress recovery stations at element ends and optional intermediate points.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The bend object shall support bend radius, bend angle, and bend plane orientation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The bend object shall support user-entered in-plane SIF, out-of-plane SIF, and torsional SIF where applicable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The bend object shall support user-entered in-plane and out-of-plane flexibility factors.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The bend object shall support user-entered pressure-stiffening or pressure-modifier settings where applicable and optional segmented visualization.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The software shall not supply protected B31J or code-derived bend values in the public distribution.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Branch connection objects shall support header element association, branch element association, intersection node, branch angle, and header/branch section assignments.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Branch connection objects shall support reinforcement metadata, user-entered header-side SIFs, and user-entered branch-side SIFs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Branch connection objects shall support user-entered local flexibility modifiers and user-entered source/provenance for each local modifier.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Rigid components shall support length, weight, center of gravity, rotational inertia metadata, local orientation, optional semi-rigid stiffness values, and source/provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Applicable rigid components include valves, flanges, strainers, instruments, specialty items, and equipment connection stubs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Reducers shall support concentric/eccentric geometry, upstream/downstream section assignments, length, weight, offset vector for eccentric reducers, and user-entered local stress modifiers where needed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Expansion joints shall support axial, lateral, angular, and torsional stiffness.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Expansion joints shall support effective pressure area, pressure thrust, and movement limits.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Expansion joints shall support tie rod/hinge/gimbal/limit rod configuration metadata and manufacturer data provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Supported support/restraint types: anchor, guide, line stop, vertical support, directional restraint, translational spring, and rotational spring.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Supported support/restraint types: constant-effort support, variable spring hanger, rigid strut, gap support, one-way support, friction support, and sliding support.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MVP may include only anchors and linear restraints; nonlinear supports should be implemented after the linear solver is validated.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Primitive load types include dead weight of pipe, contents weight, insulation/refractory/lining weight, and component weight.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Primitive load types include internal pressure metadata, temperature change or total thermal expansion data, concentrated force, and concentrated moment.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Primitive load types include imposed displacement, imposed rotation, wind load, seismic static-equivalent load, hydrotest load, and user-defined occasional load.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Load-case distinction - Primitive analysis cases: directly solved load cases such as weight, pressure, temperature, imposed displacement, wind, seismic, hydrotest, and user-defined loads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Load-case distinction - Combination cases: algebraic combinations or differences of solved cases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Load-case distinction - Rule-check cases: user-defined mapping of combinations to stress categories and allowable limits.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The public software shall include a generic load-case builder but shall not ship protected code-specific load-combination requirements.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver shall recover fundamental mechanics quantities before code evaluation: axial force, shear forces, torsional moment, local bending moments, and resultant bending moment.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver shall recover axial stress, bending stress, and torsional shear stress.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver shall recover pressure hoop stress and pressure longitudinal stress if the user selects a pressure-stress method.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The solver shall optionally recover principal stress, von Mises equivalent stress, and Tresca equivalent stress.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Code-specific stress formulas shall be handled in user rule packs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The engine shall use deterministic algorithms where practical, report solver residuals, and detect unconstrained rigid body modes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The engine shall detect duplicate or near-duplicate nodes, zero-length or invalid elements, and inconsistent units.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The engine shall store input and output values with sufficient precision for engineering review and provide reproducible results for a given project file and solver version.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The rule-pack system is the key mechanism for code-neutral software, allowing users to define code- or company-specific checks without the public software distributing protected code content.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: A rule pack shall define rule-pack name, version, code family or project standard (free text), code edition (free text), source/provenance statement, and redistribution status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: A rule pack shall define required material inputs, required component inputs, required project inputs, stress categories, and load-case mappings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: A rule pack shall define expressions, allowables, warnings, blocking conditions, and unit expectations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The rule-pack expression evaluator shall be unit-aware, sandboxed, deterministic, and non-Turing-complete if practical.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The expression evaluator shall be free of arbitrary filesystem or network access and capable of basic algebra, conditionals, min/max, interpolation, and table lookup using user-provided tables.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Public rule-pack examples may include invented demonstration values but must not include protected ASME content or copied code formulas.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Private user rule packs may include licensed or proprietary information subject to legal rights and policies; the application shall mark such rule packs private by default.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The public repository may include rule-pack examples using placeholders rather than code-specific formulas.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Example rule-pack metadata fields: name, version, source, and redistribution_allowed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Example rule pack declares required_inputs grouped into material, component, and project categories.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Example rule pack defines checks (e.g., sustained_example, displacement_example) referencing a combination, expression, allowable, and result_label.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Telemetry Policy.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The telemetry policy is a privacy and product-boundary artifact, not a telemetry implementation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The telemetry policy is not a vendor selection, cloud-service design, or professional engineering approval.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The telemetry policy is not a security certification or compliance attestation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The policy makes no claim that analysis results are fit for reliance without competent human review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Scope.
OpenPipeStress is local-first by default.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The MVP may remain a telemetry no-op.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: No telemetry transport, endpoint, vendor, background upload job, queue, or telemetry persistence is required or authorized by this policy.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: If telemetry is ever implemented, it must be opt-in only, privacy-preserving, and bounded by a human-approved event allowlist.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Installing the software, opening a project, accepting general terms, importing data, running a solve, exporting a report, or loading a plugin does not constitute telemetry consent.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Default-Off Semantics.
Telemetry is disabled by default.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Absent, unset, empty, unknown, unsupported, or malformed telemetry configuration resolves to disabled.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Fail-closed behavior is required: the application must not infer consent from ambiguous configuration, legacy configuration, environment defaults, plugin metadata, import/export settings, or runtime errors.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The exact product configuration schema, storage location, consent UI, endpoint, vendor, retention policy, transport, and concrete event schema remain TBD pending separate human approval.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Initialization Rules.

Telemetry must not initialize network transport, background upload jobs, upload queues, local telemetry persistence, endpoints, vendors, or external service clients unless all required conditions are true.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Initialization condition: the user has explicitly opted in through an approved product surface.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Initialization condition: a human-approved event allowlist exists for the exact product version.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Initialization condition: payload filtering is active before any event is constructed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Initialization condition: protected-content, private-data, secret, and professional-boundary checks are available for telemetry payload review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Initialization condition: plugin, adapter, import/export, report, and CLI paths cannot bypass the same opt-in and payload-filtering checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: If any initialization condition is missing, telemetry remains disabled and any attempted event is dropped locally without network behavior.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Event Allowlist Rules.
No event is collectable until it appears in a human-approved allowlist.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: An allowlist entry must define the event name, permitted fields, field sensitivity, review date, approving human authority, and reason collection is needed.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Unknown events, unapproved event versions, fields not listed on the allowlist, or fields with unclear sensitivity are rejected before payload construction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The allowlist may approve only low-sensitivity operational metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The allowlist cannot approve private engineering or code data unless the user explicitly selects a specific payload for a specific support or export action under a separate approved workflow.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Metadata-Only Guard Helper.
The core/security/telemetry_policy module provides a metadata-only telemetry guard helper for resolving local telemetry configuration and evaluating event attempts before any payload is built.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The guard helper accepts only telemetry configuration metadata, event names, field names, and field classifications, and returns diagnostics and a decision before payload construction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The helper is a local privacy guard and implementation-hardening artifact.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The helper does not authorize endpoint, vendor, transport, queue, upload, persistence, or telemetry payload construction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: The helper does not select a consent UI, retention policy, support-bundle workflow, cloud service, or professional review state.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: If configuration is absent, empty, unknown, unsupported, or malformed, the helper resolves telemetry to disabled.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: If an event name, field name, or field classification is unknown, unapproved, private, protected, secret-like, path-like, hash-like, report-like, or a professional/code-compliance claim, the helper rejects the attempt before payload construction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Section heading: Forbidden Payload Fields.
Telemetry payloads must not include any of the listed forbidden field classes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Forbidden payload field class: private project models, including project geometry, node coordinates, element topology, loads, load cases, boundary conditions, support settings, solve results, or project package content.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-SECURITY-TELEMETRY-POLICY -> CAT-021.

UnitStatement: Forbidden payload field class: code-specific rule data, including owner standards, company design bases, rule formulas, rule thresholds, rule inputs, rule evaluation results, or private rule logic.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Open Mechanics is public analytical mechanics implemented by the solver: geometry, stiffness, loads, stress recovery, units, reports; may be shipped publicly.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Protected Standards Data is code text, tables, figures, code-derived formulas, allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, and protected dimensional tables; must not be shipped publicly unless explicit redistribution rights exist.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: User-Supplied Code Data is values, formulas, allowables, SIFs, flexibility factors, load combinations, and interpretations entered by the user; may be stored in private project/rule-pack files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Mechanics Solve is a solved numerical model with displacements, reactions, forces, moments, and mechanical stresses; not equivalent to a code check.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Rule-Pack Check is a user-defined expression/comparison applied to solver outputs; not equivalent to professional authentication.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Professional Approval is human acceptance for reliance by a competent/responsible professional; outside software authority.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Centerline Model is a 3D line-element representation of the piping centerline and components; the default global analysis model.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Frame Kernel is the code-neutral 3D frame mechanics core owning DOF ordering, element stiffness, transforms, assembly, boundary-condition reduction, and a bounded solve interface; it consumes unit-checked numeric inputs and does not perform rule checks or professional approval.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Solver Diagnostic is a deterministic mechanics-solver finding for singularity, invalid topology/restraints, numeric invalidity, conditioning, nonconvergence, or unresolved solver configuration; not a rule-pack result, code-compliance statement, or professional acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Local FEA Handoff is a transfer package for local shell/solid analysis; a specialized workflow, not the default global solver.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Plugin Manifest is a declared extension metadata record requesting entrypoints, permissions, provenance, privacy posture, checksums, sandbox requirements, and no-bypass constraints; a manifest grants nothing by itself.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Extension Point is a governed boundary where a plugin or adapter may request to import, export, validate, report, emit diagnostics, or expose user-owned rule-pack metadata; exact loader and transport remain TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Domain Surface is the model, persistence, unit, analysis-boundary, rule-pack metadata, result, report, or diagnostic surface touched by an extension entrypoint; must be declared in the plugin manifest.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: No-Bypass Constraint is a mandatory control plugins and adapters must preserve, including units, provenance, privacy, protected-content, diagnostics, hashes, rule sandboxing, reports, solver boundaries, and human acceptance boundaries; cannot be waived by plugin code.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: USER_SUPPLIED_LICENSED_CODE provenance label means the user entered a value from a licensed code/standard.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: USER_SUPPLIED_OWNER_SPEC provenance label means the user entered a value from owner/company design basis.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MANUFACTURER_PUBLIC_PERMISSIVE provenance label means manufacturer data with documented redistribution rights.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MANUFACTURER_PRIVATE provenance label means manufacturer/vendor data for private project use only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: PUBLIC_DOMAIN_OR_ORIGINAL provenance label means public-domain/original/invented data safe for public examples.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: UNKNOWN_SOURCE provenance label means the source is not documented and cannot be relied on without review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: PROTECTED_CONTENT_SUSPECTED provenance label means quarantine and escalate before public use.

UnitStatement: schemas/model.schema.yaml defines public object structure, identifiers, references, unit-bearing values, provenance, diagnostics, results, and report settings, but does not bundle protected standards data, proprietary catalog values, code-specific allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, or compliance rules.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: PKG-02 owns the canonical semantic dimension vocabulary used by both schemas/units.schema.yaml DimensionId and schemas/model.schema.yaml Quantity.dimension.

UnitStatement: The canonical semantic dimension vocabulary includes dimensionless, length, mass, time, temperature, temperature_interval, angle, rotation, force, force_per_length, moment, pressure, stress, area, volume, density, linear_stiffness, rotational_stiffness, displacement, velocity, acceleration, thermal_conductivity, specific_heat, thermal_expansion_coefficient, second_moment_area, section_modulus, mass_per_length, volume_per_length, slope, and TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Unit catalogs, conversion constants, tolerances, code-specific values, release claims, and professional claims remain out of scope for the dimension vocabulary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Project object is the project container for units, privacy/storage posture, models, rule-pack references, report settings, reports, diagnostics, and hashes; project-private engineering data remains user controlled unless intentionally contributed with documented rights.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Model object is a physical or derived analytical model container for nodes, elements, components, materials, sections, supports, load cases, combinations, results, diagnostics, unresolved assumptions, traceability links, and references to design knowledge, constraints, operations, states/runs, comparisons, handoff packages, and external metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: The Model physical_source_of_truth role anchors editable design data; downstream PKG-13 through PKG-16 contracts own detailed records and must not bypass canonical units, provenance, diagnostics, or professional-boundary controls.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: ModelRole is a schema enum distinguishing a physical source-of-truth model from an analytical solver model, derived view, or unresolved TBD role; it is not a lifecycle or professional-approval status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: DesignKnowledgeEnvelope holds schema-first records for user-supplied endpoints, line data, routing corridors, zones, equipment interfaces, access/slope/drain/vent requirements, owner/project metadata, source notes, assumptions, diagnostics, and provenance; public examples must be invented or cleared.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: ModelStateRecord is a named immutable model snapshot record with tags, notes, external references, assumptions, warnings, analysis-status references, deterministic hashes, provenance, and read-only snapshot semantics; states are review/reproducibility records, not approval/certification/sealing/authentication/code-compliance states.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Node is an addressable point with unit-aware coordinates and six-degree-of-freedom state fields; missing imposed values or constraints are findings, not silent defaults.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Element is an analytical member connecting node references with material, section, optional component, governed local-coordinate, and result-station hooks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Straight-pipe Element local-coordinate metadata requires a y_reference orientation basis and may carry provenance; local_x_axis is not part of the canonical schema.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: FrameKernel is the Rust mechanics module for two-node 3D frame stiffness, local/global transforms, dense assembly, boundary-condition reduction, and temporary dense solve verification; sparse solver selection, canonical calculation units, conversion constants, and downstream adapters remain TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: StraightPipeElement is the Rust mechanics module that adapts explicit straight-pipe section and mass properties into the frame-kernel element boundary and recovers local mechanical element forces.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: LinearSupport is the Rust mechanics-boundary module for anchors, guides, line stops, vertical supports, linear springs, and imposed displacement data mapped to frame-kernel DOFs; nonlinear gap/lift-off/one-way/friction behavior is out of scope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: NonlinearSupportActiveSet is the Rust mechanics module that classifies one-way, gap/lift-off/contact, and friction-limited support states during nonlinear support iterations; it records active-set changes and nonconvergence diagnostics but does not assemble the global nonlinear solve.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: SolverDiagnostics is the Rust mechanics-diagnostics module mapping frame-kernel errors and solver state facts to deterministic diagnostic codes, severities, sources, and statuses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: SolverPerformanceHarness is the Rust observer/regression module that runs invented or public-permissive frame fixtures repeatedly and records matrix metrics, residuals, repeatability deltas, conditioning observations, provenance, assumptions, and limitations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: PrimitiveLoadCase is the Rust mechanics module for weight, pressure, thermal, imposed-displacement, hydrotest, wind, seismic, and occasional primitive load categories; it prepares explicit nodal, element-uniform, and imposed-displacement solver-boundary contributions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: LoadCaseAlgebra is the Rust mechanics-boundary module for user-defined linear combinations, result-state subtraction, and range envelopes over compatible load/result quantities; it preserves unit/dimension intent and analysis statuses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: UserLoadApplication is the Rust mechanics-boundary module for concentrated forces, concentrated moments, and uniform distributed user loads; it prepares explicit solver-boundary contributions and result-recovery hooks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: StressRecovery is the Rust mechanics module that recovers axial, bending, torsional, and pressure membrane stress components from explicit resultants and section/pressure inputs; it does not provide design-code equations, allowables, stress indices, or SIF/flexibility factors.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: RulePack is a user-owned schema-governed artifact defining required inputs, declarative formula slots, user-supplied value slots, user-rule check definitions, provenance, redistribution status, diagnostics, checksums, and professional-boundary flags; the schema defines structure only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: ExpressionEvaluator is the Rust rule-pack module that evaluates explicit declarative expression trees with variable bindings, dimension metadata, comparisons, and deterministic findings; it does not parse arbitrary text or execute host-language code.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: RulePackLifecycle is the Rust rule-pack module that records lifecycle metadata, privacy/redistribution status, protected-content review state, checksum records, and audit-manifest references; it hashes caller-supplied canonical payload bytes and emits lifecycle findings.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: RulePackCompletenessCheck is the Rust rule-pack module that compares required-input declarations with supplied input evidence; it emits deterministic rule-check-blocking findings and RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE readiness without evaluating formulas.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: MechanicsBenchmark is a Rust validation fixture and hand-calculation record for open mechanics behavior such as cantilever response, frame assembly, thermal growth, imposed displacement, and stiffness transforms; fixtures must be original/public/permissive with provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: StressRecoveryBenchmark is a Rust validation fixture and hand-calculation record for code-neutral stress recovery behavior; stress range is not a fatigue check, allowable comparison, code compliance decision, or professional approval.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Component is a piping-specific object such as bend, elbow, branch, reducer, valve, flange, expansion joint, rigid, specialty, or other user-defined component; user modifiers and code/manufacturer values require provenance and may be private.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Material is a user/private or permissively sourced material record with unit-bearing properties, allowable slots, completeness findings, and provenance; the public schema does not provide protected material allowables, code tables, or proprietary catalog values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Section is a pipe/section record with unit-bearing properties and provenance; protected dimensional tables and proprietary catalog data are not public defaults.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: SectionLibrary holds governed section records with user-entered dimensions, derived-property slots, completeness findings, provenance, and review status; public fixtures remain schema-shape-only or invented unless public-permissive source review is complete.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: SectionPropertyCalculation is a derived pipe section and mass-property result calculated from user-entered OD, wall, corrosion, density, contents, and insulation inputs; the calculator does not supply dimensional tables, unit conversion constants, material defaults, or catalog values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: ComponentLibrary holds governed component records for bends, branches, reducers, valves, flanges, expansion joints, rigid parts, specialty items, and user-defined components; SIFs, flexibility factors, manufacturer values, weights, COGs, stiffnesses, and movement limits require provenance and may be private.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: LibraryImportProvenanceCheck is an import-boundary validation result for material, section, and component library payloads; it records accept/reject/review/quarantine outcomes without making legal conclusions or publishing private/protected values.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: BendElbowComponent is a bend or elbow component record with user-entered centerline geometry, orientation metadata, source references, and user-supplied SIF/flexibility slots; public records define slots and diagnostics only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: BranchConnectionComponent is a branch connection component record with user-entered run/header geometry, connection angle/type slots, reinforcement references, and user-supplied SIF/flexibility slots; public records define slots and diagnostics only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: RigidComponent is a valve, flange, reducer, rigid, or specialty component record with user-entered dimensions, connection references, weight, center-of-gravity, stiffness behavior, and source references; public records define slots and diagnostics only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: ExpansionJointComponent is an expansion joint record with user/manufacturer-supplied stiffness, effective-area, movement-limit, hardware, and manufacturer-reference slots; public records define slots and diagnostics only.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Support is a restraint/support record with target reference, directions, unit-bearing properties, and active-state result hook; nonlinear solution behavior and convergence semantics are solver-owned.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: ViewportEditorSession is a schema-first viewport/editor contract for transient camera, hover, selection, drag, snap, view primitives, diagnostics, and application-service command intents over centerline model objects; viewport edits are command intents, not direct persisted-project mutations.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Combination is an algebraic grouping of load-case factors with an explicit basis; no public code-specific combination defaults are implied.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: RulePackRef is a reference to a user/public rule-pack by identity, version, checksum, source notice, redistribution status, and required-input links; rule formulas, protected interpretations, and evaluator implementation are outside this schema.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Quantity is a unit-bearing value record with magnitude, unit, dimension, and provenance; dimensionless values must be explicit and missing or incompatible units are findings, not hidden defaults.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Provenance is a source, license, contributor, redistribution, and review-status record used by reliance-affecting public/private data; unknown or suspected protected sources must remain reviewable.

UnitStatement: Reference is a typed stable-object reference used instead of positional coupling where editing, solving, reporting, or audit depends on identity; external references remain explicit and do not bypass schema validation.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Assumption is an explicit unresolved or resolved model assumption with affected references and provenance; assumptions are review evidence and cannot silently become defaults or professional acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: TraceabilityLink is a directed source/target trace record for physical-to-analytical transformation, operation application, state snapshots, analysis runs, comparisons, handoff records, or external references; it does not prove external validation, certification, or code compliance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Diagnostic is a result-envelope warning/finding record with code, class, severity, source, affected object, message, remediation, and provenance; diagnostics expose missing data and boundary risks without becoming compliance claims.

UnitStatement: Checksum is a hash metadata record with algorithm, canonicalization, payload reference, and value; JSON payload hashes use the JCS-compatible basis where applicable and SCA-003 local SQLite storage is not the authoritative hash basis.

UnitStatement: ProjectPersistenceEnvelope is a versioned create/open/save envelope with schema version, project payload, migration status, hash metadata, diagnostics, round-trip manifest, validation profile, and service-operation contract records; it delegates model structure to schemas/model.schema.yaml.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: PersistenceOperation is an application-service contract record for create, open, save, validate, version-check, and migrate operations; operations must not bypass schema, unit, provenance, rule-pack reference, private-data, protected-content, or professional-boundary checks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: RoundTripManifest is a persistence comparison record naming semantic equality categories, serialization basis, volatile fields, and normalization rules; round trips preserve engineering-relevant data and do not insert silent defaults.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Result is a mechanical, diagnostic, stress, reaction, or user-rule-check result envelope with analysis statuses and unit-aware values; result statuses do not mean automatic code compliance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: AuditManifest is a reproducibility record for model/input hashes, solver version stamp, unit-system reference, rule-pack checksum refs, asset hashes, privacy/redaction metadata, and manifest findings; it records evidence for review without storing private payloads.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: ReportSettings is a report configuration for manifests, provenance summaries, notices, result references, and rule-pack references; report rendering and professional acceptance records remain separate workflows.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.

UnitStatement: Report is an auditable report-facing record for manifests, hashes, statuses, diagnostics, rule-pack refs, provenance summary, and professional-boundary notice; reports are decision support and must not claim certification, sealing, or professional approval by the software.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-TYPES -> CAT-019.
